title.zh: 卷三 本紀第三 太祖三
title.raw: 卷三 本紀第三 太祖三 Volume 3 Annals 3: Taizu 3

sentences.zh: 十五年春正月辛巳，宴群臣於謹身殿，始用九奏樂。

translations.literal: Fifteenth year, spring, first month, on the xinsi day, he banqueted the ministers at the Hall of Self-Restraint and for the first time used the Nine-Performance music.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of his reign, on the xinsi day of the first month of spring, the emperor feasted his ministers in the Hall of Self-Restraint and, for the first time, had the Nine-Performance suite played.

sentences.zh: 景川侯曹震、定遠侯王弼下威楚路。

translations.literal: Marquis Jingchuan Cao Zhen and Marquis Dingyuan Wang Bi descended upon the Weichu route.
translations.idiomatic: Marquis Jingchuan Cao Zhen and Marquis Dingyuan Wang Bi marched down the Weichu route.

sentences.zh: 壬午，元曲靖宣慰司及中慶、澄江、武定諸路俱降，雲南平。

translations.literal: On renwu, the Yuan Qujing Pacification Commission and the circuits of Zhongqing, Chengjiang, and Wuding all surrendered; Yunnan was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, the Yuan Qujing Pacification Commission and the Zhongqing, Chengjiang, and Wuding circuits all submitted, and Yunnan was brought under control.

sentences.zh: 己丑，減大辟囚。

translations.literal: On jichou, death-penalty prisoners were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, the number of prisoners sentenced to death was reduced.

sentences.zh: 乙未，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Heaven and Earth were greatly sacrificed to at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, the emperor offered the great joint sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the southern altar.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，命天下朝覲官各舉所知一人。

translations.literal: On gengxu, he ordered officials throughout the realm attending court audience each to recommend one man he knew.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, he commanded every official in the empire who had come to court to nominate one person of known merit.

sentences.zh: 二月壬子。

translations.literal: Second month, renzi.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the renzi day.

sentences.zh: 河決河南，命駙馬都尉李祺振之。

translations.literal: The Yellow River burst its banks in Henan; he ordered the Chief Commandant of Horse Guards, Li Qi, to provide relief.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River broke through its dikes in Henan, and the emperor ordered Chief Commandant of Horse Guards Li Qi to organize relief.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以雲南平，詔天下。

translations.literal: On jiayin, because Yunnan was pacified, he issued an edict to all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, with Yunnan pacified, he proclaimed the news to the entire realm.

sentences.zh: 閏月癸卯，藍玉、沐英克大理，分兵徇鶴慶、麗江、金齒，俱下。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, guimao: Lan Yu and Mu Ying took Dali; dividing their forces they swept Heqing, Lijiang, and Jinchi—all fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the guimao day, Lan Yu and Mu Ying captured Dali, then sent columns against Heqing, Lijiang, and Jinchi, which all submitted.

sentences.zh: 三月庚午，河決朝邑。

translations.literal: Third month, gengwu: the river burst its banks at Chaoyi.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the gengwu day, the river broke its banks at Chaoyi.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲申，遷元梁王把匝剌瓦兒密及威順王子伯伯等家屬於耽羅。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, jiashen: the Yuan Liang prince Bazha'erwamier and the families of the Weishun prince Bobo and others were moved to Tamna.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the jiashen day, the Yuan Liang prince Bazha'erwamier and the households of the Weishun prince Bobo and others were resettled on Tamna.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔天下通祀孔子。

translations.literal: On bingxu, an edict ordered universal sacrifice to Confucius throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, an edict commanded that Confucius be honored with sacrifice throughout the empire.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，免畿內、浙江、江西、河南、山東稅糧。

translations.literal: On renchen, tax grain was remitted in the capital region, Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Henan, and Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, grain taxes were waived in the metropolitan districts and in Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Henan, and Shandong.

sentences.zh: 五月乙丑，太學成，釋奠於先師孔子。

translations.literal: Fifth month, yichou: the Imperial Academy was completed; the libation sacrifice was performed to the First Teacher Confucius.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the yichou day, the Imperial Academy was finished, and the ceremonial offering was made to Confucius as First Teacher.

sentences.zh: 丙子，廣平府吏王允道請開磁州鐵冶。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Wang Yundao, a clerk of Guangping Prefecture, requested that the ironworks at Cizhou be opened.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, Wang Yundao, a clerk in Guangping Prefecture, petitioned to reopen the iron smelters at Cizhou.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「朕聞王者使天下無遺賢，不聞無遺利。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "I have heard that a true king leaves no worthy man neglected in the realm; I have not heard that he leaves no profit unexploited.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "I have always understood that a ruler's duty is to leave no talent unused under Heaven—not to leave no profit unmined.

sentences.zh: 今軍器不乏，而民業已定，無益於國，且重擾民。

translations.literal: Now arms are not wanting, and the people's occupations are settled; this benefits the state not, and moreover greatly harasses the people.
translations.idiomatic: Our armories are full, and the people's livelihoods are settled. This would do the state no good and would only add heavy burdens to the people.

sentences.zh: 」杖之，流嶺南。

translations.literal: " He had him beaten with the staff and banished to Lingnan.
translations.idiomatic: " He had Wang beaten with the rod and banished to Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，遣行人訪經明行修之士。

translations.literal: On dingchou, traveling agents were dispatched to seek men accomplished in the classics and cultivated in conduct.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, envoys were sent out to search for scholars distinguished in the classics and upright in conduct.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙卯，河決滎澤、陽武。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, yimao: the river burst its banks at Rongze and Yangwu.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the yimao day, the river broke through at Rongze and Yangwu.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，罷四輔官。

translations.literal: On xinyou, the four chief-assistant offices were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, the four grand counselor posts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，傅友德、沐英擊烏撒蠻，大敗之。

translations.literal: On yihai, Fu Youde and Mu Ying attacked the Wusa tribesmen and inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, Fu Youde and Mu Ying struck the Wusa tribes and won a crushing victory.

sentences.zh: 八月丁丑，復設科取士，三年一行，為定制。

translations.literal: Eighth month, dingchou: the civil-service examinations were reinstituted, held once every three years, and made the standing rule.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the dingchou day, the civil examination was restored, to be held every three years as permanent regulation.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，皇后崩。

translations.literal: On bingxu, the Empress died.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, the empress died.

sentences.zh: 己丑，延安侯唐勝宗、長興侯耿炳文屯田陝西。

translations.literal: On jichou, Marquis of Yan'an Tang Shengzong and Marquis of Changxing Geng Bingwen undertook military-agricultural colonies in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, Marquis of Yan'an Tang Shengzong and Marquis of Changxing Geng Bingwen established garrison farms in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，擢秀才曾泰為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: On dingyou, the xiucai Zeng Tai was promoted to Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, the licentiate Zeng Tai was elevated to Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，命徵至秀才分六科試用。

translations.literal: On xinchou, he ordered the xiucai who had been summoned to be tried out in six specialties.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, he commanded the summoned licentiates to be tested and assigned among six branches of service.

sentences.zh: 九月己酉，吏部以經明行修之士鄭韜等三千七百餘人入見，令舉所知，復遣使徵之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, jiyou: the Ministry of Personnel presented more than 3,700 men accomplished in the classics and cultivated in conduct for audience; he ordered them each to recommend those they knew, and again dispatched envoys to summon them.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the jiyou day, the Ministry of Personnel presented over thirty-seven hundred scholars accomplished in the classics and upright in conduct for audience. The emperor ordered each to name others he knew, and sent envoys out again to summon them.

sentences.zh: 賜韜等鈔，尋各授布政使、參政等官有差。

translations.literal: Zheng Tao and the others were given paper money; before long each was appointed, with differences in rank, as provincial administration commissioner, vice commissioner, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Tao and the rest were granted banknotes, and soon afterward were appointed, according to rank, as provincial administration commissioners, vice commissioners, and similar posts.

sentences.zh: 庚午，葬孝慈皇后於孝陵。

translations.literal: On gengwu, the Filial and Kind Empress was buried at Xiaoling.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, the Filial and Kind Empress was interred at Xiaoling.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙子，置都察院。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, bingzi: the Censorate was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the bingzi day, the Censorate was established.

sentences.zh: 丙申，錄囚。

translations.literal: On bingshen, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, criminal cases were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，徐達還。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Xu Da returned.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, Xu Da returned to court.

sentences.zh: 是月，廣東群盜平，詔趙庸班師。

translations.literal: That month, bandits in Guangdong were pacified; an edict ordered Zhao Yong to withdraw his army.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the outlaw bands in Guangdong were suppressed, and Zhao Yong was ordered to withdraw his troops.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊午，置殿閣大學士，以邵質、吳伯宗、宋訥、吳沉為之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, wuwu: Grand Academicians of the Hall and Pavilions were appointed—Shao Zhi, Wu Bozong, Song Na, and Wu Chen were made such.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the wuwu day, grand academicians of the Hall and Pavilions were installed, with Shao Zhi, Wu Bozong, Song Na, and Wu Chen appointed to the posts.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛卯，振北平被災屯田士卒。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, xinmao: soldiers on disaster-stricken military colonies in northern Ping were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the xinmao day, relief was granted to troops farming disaster-hit colonies in northern Ping.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，永城侯薛顯理山西軍務。

translations.literal: On yihai, Marquis of Yongcheng Xue Xian took charge of military affairs in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, Marquis of Yongcheng Xue Xian was put in charge of military affairs in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 是年，爪哇、琉球、烏斯藏、占城入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Java, Ryukyu, U-Tsang, and Champa sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, embassies arrived from Java, Ryukyu, U-Tsang, and Champa.

sentences.zh: 十六年春正月乙卯，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: Sixteenth year, spring, first month, yimao: Heaven and Earth were greatly sacrificed to at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, on the yimao day of the first month of spring, the emperor offered the great joint sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the southern altar.

sentences.zh: 戊午，徐達鎮北平。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Xu Da garrisoned northern Ping.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, Xu Da took up command of the northern Ping garrison.

sentences.zh: 二月丙申，初命天下學校歲貢士於京師。

translations.literal: Second month, bingshen: for the first time he ordered schools throughout the realm to present graduates annually to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the bingshen day, he decreed for the first time that schools across the empire should send graduates to the capital each year.

sentences.zh: 三月甲辰，召征南師還，沐英留鎮雲南。

translations.literal: Third month, jiachen: the southern campaign army was recalled; Mu Ying remained to garrison Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the jiachen day, the southern expeditionary force was recalled, while Mu Ying stayed behind to guard Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，復鳳陽、臨淮二縣民徭賦，世世無所與。

translations.literal: On bingyin, corvée and tax levies were restored for the people of Fengyang and Linhuai counties, exempt forever from such burdens.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, corvée and tax obligations were lifted for the people of Fengyang and Linhuai, who were forever freed from those levies.

sentences.zh: 夏五月庚申，免畿內各府田租。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, gengshen: land rent in the capital region was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on the gengshen day, field rents in the metropolitan districts were waived.

sentences.zh: 六月辛卯，免畿內十二州縣養馬戶田租一年，滁州免二年。

translations.literal: Sixth month, xinmao: land rent was remitted for one year for households raising horses in twelve prefectures and counties within the capital region; Chuzhou was remitted for two years.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the xinmao day, field rents were waived for one year for horse-rearing households in twelve metropolitan counties and prefectures, and for two years in Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，分遣御史錄囚。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month: censors were dispatched separately to review prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, censors were sent out in separate circuits to review criminal cases.

sentences.zh: 八月壬申朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, renshen, first day of the month: there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eighth month, renshen, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 九月癸亥，申國公鄧鎮為征南將軍，討龍泉山寇，平之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, guihai: Duke of Shen Guo Zhen was made Southern Campaigning General; he attacked the Longquan Mountain bandits and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the guihai day, Duke of Shen Guo Zhen was appointed southern campaigning general, crushed the bandits of Longquan Mountain, and restored order.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁丑，召徐達等還。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, dingchou: Xu Da and others were summoned back.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the dingchou day, Xu Da and the others were recalled to court.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲午，刑部尚書開濟有罪誅。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, jiawu: Minister of Justice Kai Ji, guilty of a crime, was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the jiawu day, Minister of Justice Kai Ji was put to death for his offenses.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球、占城、西番、打箭爐、暹羅、須文達那入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Ryukyu, Champa, the Western Barbarians, Dajianlu, Siam, and Suwannadham sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, embassies arrived from Ryukyu, Champa, the western tribes, Dajianlu, Siam, and Suwannadham.

sentences.zh: 十七年春正月丁未，太祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: Seventeenth year, spring, first month, dingwei: Heaven and Earth were greatly sacrificed to at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, on the dingwei day of the first month of spring, the emperor offered the great joint sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the southern altar.

sentences.zh: 戊申，徐達鎮北平。

translations.literal: On wushen, Xu Da garrisoned northern Ping.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, Xu Da returned to garrison northern Ping.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，湯和巡視沿海諸城防倭。

translations.literal: On renxu, Tang He inspected the coastal cities to guard against Japanese pirates.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, Tang He toured the coastal defenses to prepare against Japanese raiders.

sentences.zh: 三月戊戌朔，頒科舉取士式。

translations.literal: Third month, wuxu, first day of the month: the form of the civil examination for selecting scholars was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the third month, wuxu, the regulations for the civil examination were issued.

sentences.zh: 曹國公李文忠卒。

translations.literal: Duke of Cao Li Wenzhong died.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Cao Li Wenzhong died.

sentences.zh: 甲子，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On jiazi, a great amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the empire.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬午，論平雲南功，進封傅友德潁國公，陳桓恆等侯者四人，大賚將士。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, renwu: the merit in pacifying Yunnan was discussed; Fu Youde was advanced to Duke of Ying; four others including Chen Huan were made marquises; the officers and soldiers were richly rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the renwu day, rewards for pacifying Yunnan were apportioned: Fu Youde was promoted to Duke of Ying, Chen Huan and three others were ennobled as marquises, and the troops were granted lavish gifts.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，收陣亡遺骸。

translations.literal: On gengyin, the bones of the fallen in battle were gathered.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, the remains of soldiers killed in action were collected for burial.

sentences.zh: 增築國子學舍。

translations.literal: The buildings of the Imperial Academy were enlarged.
translations.idiomatic: The halls of the Imperial Academy were expanded.

sentences.zh: 五月丙寅，涼州指揮宋晟討西番於亦集乃，敗之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, bingyin: Song Sheng, commander of Liangzhou, attacked the Western Barbarians at Yijinai and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the bingyin day, Liangzhou commander Song Sheng campaigned against the western tribes at Yijinai and routed them.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊戌，禁內官預外事，敕諸司毋通內官監文移。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, wuxu: palace eunuchs were forbidden to meddle in outside affairs; all offices were charged not to pass documents to the eunuch directorates.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the wuxu day, palace eunuchs were barred from outside affairs, and every agency was forbidden to route documents through the eunuch directorates.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔百官迎養父母者，官給舟車。

translations.literal: On guichou, an edict ordered that officials who went to receive and support their parents should be provided boats and carts at state expense.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, an edict decreed that officials traveling to care for their parents would be furnished boats and carriages at government expense.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，免畿內今年田租之半。

translations.literal: On dingsi, half of this year's land rent in the capital region was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, half of the year's field rents in the metropolitan districts were waived.

sentences.zh: 庚申，錄囚。

translations.literal: On gengshen, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, criminal cases were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，盱貽人獻天書，斬之。

translations.literal: On renxu, a man of Xuyi presented a "Heaven Book"; he was beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, a man from Xuyi presented a forged "Heaven Book" and was executed.

sentences.zh: 八月丙寅，河決開封。

translations.literal: Eighth month, bingyin: the river burst its banks at Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the bingyin day, the river broke through at Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 壬申，決杞縣，遣官塞之。

translations.literal: On renshen, it broke through at Qi County; officials were dispatched to block it.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, the breach opened at Qi County, and officials were sent to seal the dikes.

sentences.zh: 己丑，蠲河南諸省逋賦。

translations.literal: On jichou, overdue taxes in the provinces of Henan were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, delinquent taxes in Henan and neighboring provinces were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙子，河南、北平大水，分遣駙馬都尉李祺等振之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, bingzi: great floods struck Henan and northern Ping; Li Qi and other chief commandants of horse guards were dispatched separately to provide relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the bingzi day, severe flooding hit Henan and northern Ping, and Chief Commandant of Horse Guards Li Qi and others were sent out to organize relief.

sentences.zh: 閏月癸丑，詔天下罪囚，刑部、都察院詳議，大理寺覆讞後奏決。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, guichou: an edict ordered criminal prisoners throughout the realm to be reviewed in detail by the Ministry of Justice and the Censorate, and after the Court of Judicial Review had re-examined the cases, to be reported for decision.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the guichou day, an edict required that prisoners empire-wide be reviewed by the Ministry of Justice and the Censorate, then re-adjudicated by the Court of Judicial Review before final sentence was submitted to the throne.

sentences.zh: 是月，召徐達還。

translations.literal: That month, Xu Da was summoned back.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Xu Da was recalled to court.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬子，蠲雲南逋賦。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, renzi: overdue levies in Yunnan were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the renzi day, delinquent taxes in Yunnan were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球、暹羅、安南、占城入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Ryukyu, Siam, Annam, and Champa sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, embassies arrived from Ryukyu, Siam, Annam, and Champa.

sentences.zh: 十八年春正月辛未，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: Eighteenth year, spring, first month, xinwei: Heaven and Earth were greatly sacrificed to at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, on the xinwei day of the first month of spring, the emperor offered the great joint sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the southern altar.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，朝覲官分五等考績，黜陟有差。

translations.literal: On guiyou, officials attending court audience were graded in five ranks for performance review; demotions and promotions differed accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, officials presenting themselves at court were ranked in five grades for merit review, with promotions and dismissals apportioned accordingly.

sentences.zh: 二月甲辰，以久陰雨雷雹，詔臣民極言得失。

translations.literal: Second month, jiachen: because of prolonged rain, thunder, and hail, an edict invited officials and commoners to speak freely of gains and losses.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the jiachen day, after weeks of rain with thunder and hail, the emperor issued an edict inviting officials and commoners alike to speak plainly of what the government was doing right and wrong.

sentences.zh: 己未，魏國公徐達卒。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Duke of Wei Xu Da died.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, Duke of Wei Xu Da died.

sentences.zh: 三月壬戌，賜丁顯等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: Third month, renxu: Ding Xian and other jinshi were granted, with differences in rank, the titles of Presented Scholar and Advanced Scholar.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the renxu day, Ding Xian and the other jinshi were conferred, according to rank, the titles of Presented Scholar and Advanced Scholar.

sentences.zh: 詔中外官父母歿任所者，有司給舟車歸其喪，著為令。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that when officials at home or abroad lost a parent in office, the local authorities should provide boats and carts to return the coffin; this was established as regulation.
translations.idiomatic: An edict decreed that when an official's parent died while he was serving away from home, local authorities must furnish boats and carriages to convey the coffin home, and this was written into law.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，免畿內今年田租。

translations.literal: On yihai, this year's land rent in the capital region was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, the year's field rents in the metropolitan districts were waived.

sentences.zh: 命天下郡縣瘞暴骨。

translations.literal: He ordered every prefecture and county in the realm to bury exposed bones.
translations.idiomatic: He commanded every prefecture and county in the empire to inter unburied remains.

sentences.zh: 丙子，初選進士為翰林院、承敕監、六科庶起士。

translations.literal: On bingzi, for the first time jinshi were selected as Hanlin Academy bachelors, receivers of edicts in the Directorate of Transmission, and probationary compilers in the Six Offices.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, jinshi were for the first time appointed as Hanlin academicians, edict receivers in the Directorate of Transmission, and probationary compilers in the Six Offices.

sentences.zh: 己丑，戶部侍郎郭桓坐盜官糧誅。

translations.literal: On jichou, Vice Minister of Revenue Guo Huan, convicted of embezzling state grain, was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, Vice Minister of Revenue Guo Huan was executed for stealing government grain.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁酉，吏部尚書余熂以罪誅。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, dingyou: Minister of Personnel Yu Bi, guilty of a crime, was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the dingyou day, Minister of Personnel Yu Bi was put to death for his offenses.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，思州蠻叛，湯和為征虜將軍，周德興為副將軍，帥師從楚王楨討之。

translations.literal: On bingchen, the Sizhou tribes rebelled; Tang He was made Northern Campaigning General, Zhou Dexing vice general; they led the army following Prince Chu Zhen to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, the Sizhou tribes rose in revolt. Tang He was named northern campaigning general with Zhou Dexing as his deputy, and they marched under Prince Chu Zhen to suppress the uprising.

sentences.zh: 六月戊申，定外官三年一朝，著為令。

translations.literal: Sixth month, wushen: it was fixed that outside officials should attend court once every three years, and this was established as regulation.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the wushen day, it was decreed that provincial officials should present themselves at court once every three years, and the rule was written into law.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲戌，封王禑為高麗國王。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, jiaxu: Wang Ti was enfeoffed as King of Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the jiaxu day, Wang Ti was invested as king of Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，五開蠻叛。

translations.literal: On gengchen, the Wukai tribes rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, the Wukai tribes rose in revolt.

sentences.zh: 八月庚戌，馮勝、傅友德、藍玉備邊北平。

translations.literal: Eighth month, gengxu: Feng Sheng, Fu Youde, and Lan Yu prepared the defenses on the northern Ping frontier.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the gengxu day, Feng Sheng, Fu Youde, and Lan Yu took charge of frontier defenses in northern Ping.

sentences.zh: 是月，振河南水災。

translations.literal: That month, Henan flood victims were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That month, relief was distributed to victims of flooding in Henan.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己丑，頒《大誥》於天下。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, jichou: the Great Admonitions was promulgated throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the jichou day, the Great Admonitions was issued to the entire empire.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，召馮勝還。

translations.literal: On guimao, Feng Sheng was summoned back.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, Feng Sheng was recalled to court.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔曰：「孟子傳道，有功名教。

translations.literal: On jiachen, an edict said: "Mencius transmitted the Way and achieved merit in human relations and education.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, an edict declared, "Mencius handed down the Way and won lasting merit in teaching and moral order.

sentences.zh: 歷年既久，子孫甚微。

translations.literal: Years have grown long, and his descendants are very few.
translations.idiomatic: Centuries have passed, and his line has grown thin.

sentences.zh: 近有以罪輸作者，豈禮先賢之意哉。

translations.literal: Recently some have been sentenced to penal labor for crimes—can this be what it means to honor the former sages?
translations.idiomatic: Yet lately some of his descendants have been sentenced to penal labor for crimes. Is this how we honor a sage of old?

sentences.zh: 其加意詢訪，凡聖賢後裔輸作者，皆免之。

translations.literal: Give special care to inquiry and search: all descendants of sages and worthies sentenced to penal labor are to be pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Search them out with care: every descendant of the sages and worthies now condemned to penal labor shall be released.

sentences.zh: 」是月，楚王楨、信國公湯和討平五開蠻。

translations.literal: " That month, Prince Chu Zhen and Duke of Xin Tang He suppressed and pacified the Wukai tribes.
translations.idiomatic: " That month, Prince Chu Zhen and Duke of Xin Tang He crushed the Wukai rebels and restored order.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙亥，蠲河南、山東、北平田租。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, yihai: land rent in Henan, Shandong, and northern Ping was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the yihai day, field rents were waived in Henan, Shandong, and northern Ping.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙午，詔有司舉孝廉。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, bingwu: an edict ordered the responsible offices to recommend men of filial piety and incorrupt conduct.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the bingwu day, an edict commanded the ministries to nominate candidates for the filial-and-incorrupt recommendation.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，麓川平緬宣慰使思倫發反，都督馮誠敗績，千戶王升死之。

translations.literal: On guichou, Silunfa, Pacification Commissioner of Lucuan Pingdian, rebelled; Regional Commander Feng Cheng was defeated, and the chiliarch Wang Sheng died in the action.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, Silunfa, the Lucuan Pingdian pacification commissioner, rose in revolt. Regional Commander Feng Cheng was routed, and Company Commander Wang Sheng was killed.

sentences.zh: 是年，高麗、琉球、安南、暹羅入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Korea, Ryukyu, Annam, and Siam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, embassies arrived from Korea, Ryukyu, Annam, and Siam.

sentences.zh: 十九年春正月辛酉，振大名及江浦水災。

translations.literal: Nineteenth year, spring, first month, xinyou: relief was granted for flood disasters in Daming and Jiangpu.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, on the xinyou day of the first month of spring, flood relief was ordered for Daming and Jiangpu.

sentences.zh: 甲子，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Heaven and Earth were greatly sacrificed to at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, the emperor offered the great joint sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the southern altar.

sentences.zh: 是月，征蠻師還。

translations.literal: That month, the southern-campaign army returned.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the army campaigning against the southern tribes came home.

sentences.zh: 二月丙申，耕耤田，癸丑，振河南饑。

translations.literal: Second month, bingshen: he plowed the sacred field; on guichou, Henan famine was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the bingshen day, he performed the ceremonial plowing of the sacred field; on the guichou day, relief was sent to famine-stricken Henan.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲辰，詔贖河南饑民所鬻子女。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, jiachen: an edict ordered the redemption of sons and daughters sold by famine refugees in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the jiachen day, an edict commanded that children sold by starving families in Henan be bought back at state expense.

sentences.zh: 六月甲辰，詔有司存問高年。

translations.literal: Sixth month, jiachen: an edict ordered the responsible offices to inquire after the aged.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the jiachen day, an edict required officials to register and care for the elderly.

sentences.zh: 貧民年八十以上，月給米五鬥，酒三鬥，肉五斤；

translations.literal: Poor persons aged eighty or more were given five dou of grain per month, three dou of wine, and five jin of meat;
translations.idiomatic: Poor people eighty years of age or older were granted five dou of grain each month, three dou of wine, and five jin of meat;

sentences.zh: 九十以上，歲加帛一匹，絮一斤；

translations.literal: those ninety or more received an additional bolt of cloth and one jin of floss each year;
translations.idiomatic: those ninety or older received an extra bolt of cloth and one jin of cotton floss each year;

sentences.zh: 有田產者罷給米。

translations.literal: those who owned farmland ceased to receive grain.
translations.idiomatic: anyone who still held farmland was no longer given the grain allowance.

sentences.zh: 應天、鳳陽富民年八十以上賜爵社士，九十以上鄉士；

translations.literal: Wealthy persons in Yingtian and Fengyang aged eighty or more were granted the title Community Gentleman, and those ninety or more, District Gentleman;
translations.idiomatic: In Yingtian and Fengyang, prosperous elders eighty or older were ennobled as Community Gentlemen, and those ninety or older as District Gentlemen;

sentences.zh: 天下富民八十以上裏士，九十以上社士。

translations.literal: throughout the realm, wealthy persons eighty or more were made Hamlet Gentlemen, and those ninety or more Community Gentlemen.
translations.idiomatic: empire-wide, wealthy elders eighty or older became Hamlet Gentlemen, and those ninety or older Community Gentlemen.

sentences.zh: 皆與縣官均祀，復其家。

translations.literal: All were granted sacrifice equal to that of county officials, and their households were exempted from corvée.
translations.idiomatic: They were entitled to the same ritual honors as county magistrates, and their families were freed from corvée duties.

sentences.zh: 鰥寡孤獨不能自存者，歲給米六石。

translations.literal: Widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary who could not support themselves were given six shi of grain per year.
translations.idiomatic: Widowers, widows, orphans, and others living alone who could not provide for themselves received six shi of grain annually.

sentences.zh: 士卒戰傷除其籍，賜復三年。

translations.literal: Soldiers wounded in battle were struck from the registers and granted three years' exemption from levies.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers wounded in battle were removed from the rolls and given a three-year tax and corvée exemption.

sentences.zh: 將校陣亡，其子世襲加一秩。

translations.literal: When commanders died in formation, their sons inherited office with one additional rank.
translations.idiomatic: When a field officer fell in battle, his son inherited his post with one extra grade of rank.

sentences.zh: 岩穴之士，以禮聘遣。

translations.literal: Recluses of renown were engaged by ritual invitation and sent on their way.
translations.idiomatic: Scholars living in seclusion were summoned with full ceremonial courtesy and honorably dismissed.

sentences.zh: 丁未，振青州及鄭州饑。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Qingzhou and Zhengzhou famine were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, relief was dispatched to famine-stricken Qingzhou and Zhengzhou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸未，詔舉經明行修練達時務之士。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, guiwei: an edict ordered the recommendation of men accomplished in the classics, cultivated in conduct, and practiced in current affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the guiwei day, an edict called for scholars distinguished in the classics, upright in conduct, and versed in practical governance.

sentences.zh: 年六十以上者，置翰林備顧問，六十以下，於六部、布按二司用之。

translations.literal: Those aged sixty or more were placed in the Hanlin as reserve counselors; those under sixty were employed in the six ministries and in the provincial and surveillance commissions.
translations.idiomatic: Candidates sixty or older were appointed Hanlin reserve counselors; those under sixty were assigned to the six ministries or to provincial and surveillance posts.

sentences.zh: 八月甲辰，命皇太子修泗州盱眙祖陵，葬德祖以下帝後冕服。

translations.literal: Eighth month, jiachen: the heir apparent was ordered to repair the imperial tombs at Xuyi in Sizhou and to bury the emperors and empresses from Dezu downward in full regalia.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the jiachen day, the crown prince was charged to restore the ancestral tombs at Xuyi in Sizhou and to inter Dezu and the succeeding emperors and consorts in full court dress.

sentences.zh: 九月庚申，屯田雲南。

translations.literal: On gengshen, military-agricultural colonies were established in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, garrison farms were opened in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，命官軍已亡子女幼或父母老者皆給全俸，著為令。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month: an edict ordered that when a soldier had died, if his children were young or his parents aged, the household should still receive full salary—made a standing regulation.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, an edict decreed that when a soldier died leaving young children or elderly parents, the family would continue to draw his full pay—a rule thereafter kept in force.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸未朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, guiwei, first day of the month: there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the twelfth month, guiwei, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 是月，命宋國公馮勝分兵防邊。

translations.literal: That month, Duke of Song Feng Sheng was ordered to divide his forces and guard the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Duke of Song Feng Sheng was directed to split his command and reinforce the border.

sentences.zh: 發北平、山東、山西、河南民運糧於大寧。

translations.literal: The people of Beiping, Shandong, Shanxi, and Henan were levied to transport grain to Daning.
translations.idiomatic: Civilians in Beiping, Shandong, Shanxi, and Henan were conscripted to haul grain to Daning.

sentences.zh: 是年，高麗、琉球、暹羅、占城、安南入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Korea, Ryukyu, Siam, Champa, and Annam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, embassies arrived from Korea, Ryukyu, Siam, Champa, and Annam.

sentences.zh: 二十年春正月癸丑，馮勝為征虜大將軍，傅友德、藍玉副之，率師征納哈出。

translations.literal: Twentieth year, spring, first month, guichou: Feng Sheng was made Great General Who Pacifies the Barbarians, with Fu Youde and Lan Yu as deputies, and led an army to campaign against Naghachu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, on the guichou day of the first month of spring, Feng Sheng was appointed Great General Who Pacifies the Barbarians, with Fu Youde and Lan Yu as his lieutenants, and marched north against Naghachu.

sentences.zh: 焚錦衣衛刑具，以繫囚付刑部。

translations.literal: The torture implements of the Embroidered-Uniform Guard were burned, and prisoners under its charge were handed over to the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: The Embroidered-Uniform Guard's instruments of torture were destroyed, and its detainees were transferred to the Ministry of Justice.

sentences.zh: 甲子，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Heaven and Earth were greatly sacrificed to at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, the emperor offered the great joint sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the southern altar.

sentences.zh: 禮成，天氣清明。

translations.literal: When the rites were complete, the weather was clear and bright.
translations.idiomatic: After the ceremony, the sky was clear and bright.

sentences.zh: 侍臣進曰：「此陛下敬天之誠所致。

translations.literal: Attending ministers advanced and said: "This is brought about by Your Majesty's sincerity in revering Heaven."
translations.idiomatic: A minister at his side remarked, "Surely this is Heaven's reward for Your Majesty's reverent sacrifice."

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「所謂敬天者，不獨嚴而有禮，當有其實。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "What is called revering Heaven is not reverence with ceremony alone; there must be substance to it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied, "To revere Heaven is not merely to perform the rites with punctilio—there must be substance behind the form.

sentences.zh: 天以子民之任付於君，為君者欲求事天，必先恤民。

translations.literal: Heaven entrusts the charge of nurturing the people to the ruler; if a ruler wishes to serve Heaven, he must first show compassion to the people.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven charges the ruler with the care of the people. Whoever would serve Heaven must first comfort the people.

sentences.zh: 恤民者，事天之實也。

translations.literal: Compassion for the people is the substance of serving Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Compassion for the people is what it means, in truth, to serve Heaven.

sentences.zh: 即如國家命人任守令之事，若不能福民，則是棄君之命，不敬孰大焉。

translations.literal: It is just as when the state appoints a man to the post of magistrate: if he cannot bring blessing to the people, he has abandoned the ruler's commission—what irreverence could be greater?"
translations.idiomatic: It is like appointing a man prefect: if he cannot bless those under him, he has betrayed his sovereign's trust—what failure of reverence could be worse?"

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「為人君者，父天母地子民，皆職分之所當盡，祀天地，非祈福於己，實為天下蒼生也。

translations.literal: He also said: "For a ruler, Heaven is father, Earth mother, and the people his children—all duties of his station that he must fulfill. Sacrificing to Heaven and Earth is not to seek blessing for himself, but truly for the myriad living beings under Heaven."
translations.idiomatic: He went on, "A ruler stands to Heaven as to a father, to Earth as to a mother, and to the people as to children—each bond a duty of his office. The sacrifice is not to win fortune for himself, but for all the living under Heaven."

sentences.zh: 」二月壬午，閱武。

translations.literal: Second month, renwu: military review.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the renwu day, troops were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 乙未，耕耤田。

translations.literal: On yiwei, he plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, he performed the ceremonial plowing of the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 三月辛亥，馮勝率師出松亭關，城大寧、寬河、會州、富峪。

translations.literal: Third month, xinhai: Feng Sheng led his army out through Songting Pass and walled Daning, Kuanhe, Huizhou, and Fuyu.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the xinhai day, Feng Sheng marched through Songting Pass and fortified Daning, Kuanhe, Huizhou, and Fuyu.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊子，江夏侯周德興築福建瀕海城，練兵防倭。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, wuzi: Marquis of Jiangxia Zhou Dexing built coastal cities in Fujian and drilled troops against Japanese pirates.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the wuzi day, Marquis of Jiangxia Zhou Dexing constructed fortified towns along the Fujian coast and trained garrisons against Japanese raiders.

sentences.zh: 六月庚子，臨江侯陳鏞從征失道，戰沒。

translations.literal: Sixth month, gengzi: Marquis of Linjiang Chen Yong, on the expedition, lost his way and died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the gengzi day, Marquis of Linjiang Chen Yong, having lost contact on campaign, was killed in action.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，馮勝兵逾金山。

translations.literal: On guimao, Feng Sheng's army crossed Jinshan.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, Feng Sheng's column crossed Jinshan.

sentences.zh: 丁未，納哈出降。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Naghachu surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, Naghachu submitted.

sentences.zh: 閏月庚申，師還次金山，都督濮英殿軍遇伏，死之。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, gengshen: the army, returning, halted at Jinshan; Regional Commander Pu Ying, bringing up the rear, met an ambush and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the gengshen day, the army withdrew to Jinshan; Regional Commander Pu Ying, commanding the rearguard, was ambushed and killed.

sentences.zh: 秋八月癸酉，收馮勝將軍印，召還，藍玉攝軍事。

translations.literal: Autumn, eighth month, guiyou: Feng Sheng's general's seal was taken back and he was recalled; Lan Yu took charge of the army.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on the guiyou day, Feng Sheng's command seal was confiscated and he was recalled, while Lan Yu assumed field command.

sentences.zh: 景川侯曹震屯田雲南品甸。

translations.literal: Marquis of Jingchuan Cao Zhen established military-agricultural colonies at Pindian in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Marquis of Jingchuan Cao Zhen opened garrison farms at Pindian in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 九月戊寅，封納哈出海西侯。

translations.literal: Ninth month, wuyin: Naghachu was enfeoffed as Marquis of Haixi.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the wuyin day, Naghachu was created Marquis of Haixi.

sentences.zh: 癸未，置大寧都指揮使司。

translations.literal: On guiwei, the Daning Regional Military Commission was established.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, the Daning regional military commission was established.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，安置鄭國公常茂於龍州。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Duke of Zheng Chang Mao was settled at Longzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, Duke of Zheng Chang Mao was placed under residence surveillance at Longzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁未，藍玉為征虜大將軍，延安侯唐勝宗、武定侯郭英副之，北征沙漠。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Lan Yu was made Great General Who Pacifies the Barbarians, with Marquis of Yan'an Tang Shengzong and Marquis of Wuding Guo Ying as deputies, and campaigned north into the desert.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, Lan Yu was appointed Great General Who Pacifies the Barbarians, with Marquis of Yan'an Tang Shengzong and Marquis of Wuding Guo Ying as lieutenants, and marched north into the desert.

sentences.zh: 是月，城西寧。

translations.literal: That month, the western walls of the capital were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the western ramparts of the capital were rebuilt.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊申，封硃壽為舳艫侯，張赫為航海侯。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, wushen: Zhu Shou was enfeoffed as Marquis of the Tower Ships, and Zhang He as Marquis of the Voyages.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the wushen day, Zhu Shou was created Marquis of the Tower Ships and Zhang He Marquis of the Voyages.

sentences.zh: 是月，馮勝罷歸鳳陽，奉朝請。

translations.literal: That month, Feng Sheng was dismissed and returned to Fengyang, attending court at invitation.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Feng Sheng was relieved of command, retired to Fengyang, and attended court when summoned.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬午，普定侯陳桓、靖甯侯葉升屯田定邊、姚安、畢節諸衛。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, renwu: Marquis of Puding Chen Huan and Marquis of Jingning Ye Sheng established military-agricultural colonies in the guards of Dingbian, Yao'an, and Bijie.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the renwu day, Marquis of Puding Chen Huan and Marquis of Jingning Ye Sheng opened garrison farms in the Dingbian, Yao'an, and Bijie guards.

sentences.zh: 己丑，湯和還，凡築寧海、臨山等五十九城。

translations.literal: On jichou, Tang He returned, having in all built fifty-nine cities including Ninghai and Linshan.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, Tang He came back, having altogether fortified fifty-nine towns, among them Ninghai and Linshan.

sentences.zh: 十二月，振登、萊饑。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: Dengzhou and Laizhou famine were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, relief was sent to famine-stricken Deng and Lai.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球、安南、高麗、占城、真臘、朵甘、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Ryukyu, Annam, Korea, Champa, Zhenla, Dgan, and U-Tsang sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, embassies arrived from Ryukyu, Annam, Korea, Champa, Zhenla, Dgan, and U-Tsang.

sentences.zh: 二十一年春正月辛巳，麓川蠻思倫發入寇馬龍他郎甸，都督甯正擊敗之。

translations.literal: Twenty-first year, spring, first month, xinsi: the Lucuan barbarian Silunfa invaded Malong and Talang, and Regional Commander Ning Zheng defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, on the xinsi day of the first month of spring, the Lucuan chieftain Silunfa raided Malong and Talang; Regional Commander Ning Zheng drove him back.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Heaven and Earth were greatly sacrificed to at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, the emperor offered the great joint sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the southern altar.

sentences.zh: 甲午，振青州饑，逮治有司匿不以聞者。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Qingzhou famine was relieved, and officials who had concealed the disaster and failed to report it were arrested and punished.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, relief reached famine-stricken Qingzhou, and officials who had hidden the crisis from the throne were seized and disciplined.

sentences.zh: 三月乙亥，賜任亨泰等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: Third month, yihai: Ren Hentai and the other jinshi were granted differing ranks of metropolitan graduate and regular graduate.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the yihai day, Ren Hentai and the other palace graduates were ranked with distinctions between metropolitan degree and regular degree.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，振東昌饑。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Dongchang famine was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, relief was dispatched to famine-stricken Dongchang.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，沐英討思倫發敗之。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Mu Ying attacked Silunfa and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, Mu Ying campaigned against Silunfa and routed him.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙辰，藍玉襲破元嗣君於捕魚兒海，獲其次子地保奴及妃主王公以下數萬人而還。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, bingchen: Lan Yu at Buyur Lake surprised and broke the Yuan heir, capturing his second son Tibulunu and the consorts, princes, and kings below them—several myriads of persons—and returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the bingchen day, Lan Yu fell upon the Yuan heir at Buyur Lake, seized his second son Tibulunu together with consorts, princes, and nobles—tens of thousands in all—and marched home in triumph.

sentences.zh: 五月甲戌朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, jiaxu, first day of the month: there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fifth month, jiaxu, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 六月甲辰，信國公湯和歸鳳陽。

translations.literal: Sixth month, jiachen: Duke of Xin Tang He returned to Fengyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the jiachen day, Duke of Xin Tang He retired to Fengyang.

sentences.zh: 甲子，傅友德為征南將軍，沐英、陳桓為左、右副將軍，帥師討東川叛蠻。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Fu Youde was made General Who Campaigns South, with Mu Ying and Chen Huan as left and right deputy generals, and led an army to suppress the rebellious eastern Sichuan tribes.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, Fu Youde was appointed southern campaigning general, with Mu Ying and Chen Huan as his lieutenants, and marched to crush the rebel tribes of eastern Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊寅，安置地保奴於琉球。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, wuyin: Tibulunu was settled in Ryukyu.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the wuyin day, Tibulunu was resettled on Ryukyu.

sentences.zh: 八月癸丑，徙澤、潞民無業者墾河南、北田，賜鈔備農具，復三年。

translations.literal: Eighth month, guichou: unoccupied people of Ze and Lu prefectures were moved to open fields in northern and southern Henan, granted paper money for farm tools, and exempted for three years.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the guichou day, idle households from Ze and Lu were relocated to reclaim land in northern and southern Henan, given banknotes for tools, and granted a three-year tax holiday.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，藍玉師還，大賚北征將士。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Lan Yu's army returned, and the northern-campaign officers and soldiers were richly rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, Lan Yu's army came home, and the northern expedition was rewarded with lavish gifts.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，封孫恪為全甯侯。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Sun Ke was enfeoffed as Marquis of Quanning.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, Sun Ke was created Marquis of Quanning.

sentences.zh: 是月，禦制八諭飭武臣。

translations.literal: That month, the Emperor personally composed the Eight Admonitions to restrain military officers.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the emperor issued his own Eight Admonitions to discipline the martial nobility.

sentences.zh: 九月丙戌，秦、晉、燕、周、楚、齊、湘、魯、潭九王來朝。

translations.literal: Ninth month, bingxu: the nine princes of Qin, Jin, Yan, Zhou, Chu, Qi, Xiang, Lu, and Tan came to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the bingxu day, the nine princes of Qin, Jin, Yan, Zhou, Chu, Qi, Xiang, Lu, and Tan presented themselves at court.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，越州蠻阿資叛，沐英會傅友德討之。

translations.literal: On jisi, the Yuezhou tribesman Azi rebelled; Mu Ying joined Fu Youde to campaign against him.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, the Yuezhou chieftain Azi rose in revolt; Mu Ying marched with Fu Youde to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁未，東川蠻平。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, dingwei: the eastern Sichuan tribes were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the dingwei day, order was restored in eastern Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬戌，進封藍玉涼國公。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, renxu: Lan Yu was advanced to Duke of Liang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the renxu day, Lan Yu was promoted to Duke of Liang.

sentences.zh: 是年，高麗、古城、琉球、暹羅、真臘、撒馬兒罕、安南入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Korea, Gucheng, Ryukyu, Siam, Zhenla, Samarqand, and Annam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, embassies arrived from Korea, Champa, Ryukyu, Siam, Zhenla, Samarqand, and Annam.

sentences.zh: 詔安南三歲一朝，象犀之屬毋獻。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Annam to present tribute once every three years and not to offer elephants, rhinoceros horn, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: An edict fixed Annam's tribute mission at once every three years and barred gifts of elephants, rhinoceros horn, and similar luxuries.

sentences.zh: 安南黎季犛弒其主煒。

translations.literal: Li Jili of Annam murdered his lord Wei.
translations.idiomatic: In Annam, Li Jili assassinated his sovereign Wei.

sentences.zh: 二十二年春正月丙戌，改大宗正院曰宗人府，以秦王樉為宗人令，晉王、燕王棣為左、右宗正，周王橚、楚王楨為左、右宗人。

translations.literal: Twenty-second year, spring, first month, bingxu: the Great Court of the Imperial Clan was renamed the Imperial Clan Court; the Prince of Qin was made Director of the Imperial Clan, the Princes of Jin and Yan left and right Directors of the Imperial Clan, and the Princes of Zhou and Chu left and right Masters of the Imperial Clan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year, on the bingxu day of the first month of spring, the Great Court of the Imperial Clan was retitled the Imperial Clan Court; the Prince of Qin became director, the Princes of Jin and Yan left and right vice directors, and the Princes of Zhou and Chu left and right masters of the clan.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Heaven and Earth were greatly sacrificed to at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, the emperor offered the great joint sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the southern altar.

sentences.zh: 乙未，傅友德破阿資於普安。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Fu Youde defeated Azi at Pu'an.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, Fu Youde routed Azi at Pu'an.

sentences.zh: 二月己未，藍玉練兵四川。

translations.literal: Second month, jiwei: Lan Yu drilled troops in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the jiwei day, Lan Yu trained troops in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，禁武臣預民事。

translations.literal: On renxu, military officers were forbidden to intervene in civil affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, martial nobles were barred from meddling in civilian government.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，湖廣千戶夏得忠結九溪蠻作亂，靖甯侯葉升討平之，得忠伏誅。

translations.literal: On guihai, the chiliarch of Huguang Xia Dezong joined the Jiuxi tribes in rebellion; Marquis of Jingning Ye Sheng suppressed them and Dezong was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, Huguang company commander Xia Dezong allied with the Jiuxi tribes in revolt; Marquis of Jingning Ye Sheng crushed the uprising and Dezong was put to death.

sentences.zh: 是月，阿資降。

translations.literal: That month, Azi surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Azi submitted.

sentences.zh: 三月庚午，傅友德帥諸將分屯四川，湖廣，防西南蠻。

translations.literal: Third month, gengwu: Fu Youde led the generals in separate garrisons in Sichuan and Huguang to guard against the southwestern tribes.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the gengwu day, Fu Youde stationed his generals across Sichuan and Huguang to watch the southwestern frontier.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己亥，徙江南民田淮南，賜鈔備農具，復三年。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, jihai: the people of Jiangnan were moved to open fields in Huainan, granted paper money for farm tools, and exempted for three years.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the jihai day, Jiangnan households were resettled to reclaim land in Huainan, given banknotes for tools, and granted a three-year exemption.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，魏國公徐允恭、開國公常升等練兵湖廣。

translations.literal: On guichou, Duke of Wei Xu Yun'gong, Duke of Qi Chang Sheng, and others drilled troops in Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, Duke of Wei Xu Yun'gong, Duke of Qi Chang Sheng, and others trained armies in Huguang.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，徙元降王於眈羅。

translations.literal: On jiayin, the surrendered Yuan kings were moved to Tamna.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, the surrendered Yuan princes were resettled on Tamna.

sentences.zh: 是月，遣御史按山東官匿災不奏者。

translations.literal: That month, censors were dispatched to investigate Shandong officials who had concealed disasters and failed to memorialize them.
translations.idiomatic: That month, investigating censors were sent to punish Shandong officials who had hidden famine reports from the throne.

sentences.zh: 五月辛卯，置泰甯、朵顏、福余三衛於兀良哈。

translations.literal: Fifth month, xinmao: the three guards of Taining, Doyan, and Fuyu were established among the Uriangqai.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the xinmao day, the Taining, Doyan, and Fuyu guards were set up among the Uriangqai.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，傅友德等還。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month: Fu Youde and the others returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, Fu Youde and his colleagues came back to court.

sentences.zh: 八月乙卯，詔天下舉高年有德識時務者。

translations.literal: Eighth month, yimao: an edict ordered the realm to recommend men of advanced age, virtue, and knowledge of current affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the yimao day, an edict called empire-wide for elders of proven virtue who understood the needs of the age.

sentences.zh: 是月，更定《大明律》。

translations.literal: That month, the Great Ming Code was revised.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the Great Ming Code was promulgated in revised form.

sentences.zh: 九月丙寅朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, bingyin, first day of the month: there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the ninth month, bingyin, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月丙寅，宣德侯金鎮等練兵湖廣。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, bingyin: Marquis of Xuan Jin Zhen and others drilled troops in Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on the bingyin day, Marquis of Xuan Jin Zhen and others trained armies in Huguang.

sentences.zh: 己卯，思倫發入貢謝罪，麓川平。

translations.literal: On jimao, Si Lunfa came to court with tribute to beg forgiveness; Luc Chuan was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, Si Lunfa presented tribute at court to plead for pardon, and Luc Chuan was brought to peace.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲辰，周王橚有罪，遷雲南，尋罷徙，留居京師。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, jiachen: Prince of Zhou Shu was guilty of a crime and was moved to Yunnan; soon the exile was revoked, and he was kept at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the jiachen day, Prince of Zhou Shu was found guilty and ordered to Yunnan; before long the sentence was set aside, and he was detained at the capital.

sentences.zh: 定遠侯王弼等練兵山西、河南、陝西。

translations.literal: Marquis of Dingyuan Wang Bi and others drilled troops in Shanxi, Henan, and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Marquis of Dingyuan Wang Bi and others conducted military training in Shanxi, Henan, and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 是年，高麗、安南、占城、暹羅、真臘入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Korea, Annam, Champa, Siam, and Zhenla sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, embassies arrived from Korea, Annam, Champa, Siam, and Zhenla.

sentences.zh: 元也速迭兒弒其主脫古思帖木兒而立坤帖木兒。

translations.literal: In the Yuan, Yeshudie'er murdered his lord Toghus Temür and enthroned Kun Temür.
translations.idiomatic: Among the Yuan, Yeshudie'er assassinated the ruler Toghus Temür and set Kun Temür on the throne.

sentences.zh: 高麗廢其主禑，又廢其主昌。

translations.literal: Korea deposed its ruler U, and again deposed its ruler Chang.
translations.idiomatic: Korea deposed King U, then deposed King Chang in turn.

sentences.zh: 安南黎季犛復弒其主日焜。

translations.literal: In Annam, Li Jili again murdered his lord Nhat Quang.
translations.idiomatic: In Annam, Li Jili once more assassinated his sovereign Nhat Quang.

sentences.zh: 二十三年春正月丁卯，晉王、燕王棣帥師征元丞相咬住、太尉乃兒不花，征虜前將軍潁國公傅友德等皆聽節制。

translations.literal: Twenty-third year, spring, first month, dingmao: Prince of Jin Gang and Prince of Yan Di led armies to campaign against the Yuan chancellor Yaqushili and Grand Preceptor Nir Buqa; Forward General against the Barbarians Duke of Ying Fu Youde and the rest were all placed under their command.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, on the dingmao day of the first month of spring, Prince of Jin Gang and Prince of Yan Di took the field against the Yuan chancellor Yaqushili and Grand Preceptor Nir Buqa, with Duke of Ying Fu Youde, forward general against the barbarians, and the other commanders all subject to their orders.

sentences.zh: 己卯，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On jimao, Heaven and Earth were greatly sacrificed to at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, the emperor offered the great joint sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the southern altar.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，貴州蠻叛，延安侯唐勝宗討平之。

translations.literal: On gengchen, the tribes of Guizhou rebelled; Marquis of Yan'an Tang Shengzong campaigned and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, the Guizhou tribes rose in revolt, and Marquis of Yan'an Tang Shengzong marched against them and restored order.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，齊王榑帥師從燕王棣北征。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Prince of Qi Fu led an army to follow Prince of Yan Di on the northern expedition.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, Prince of Qi Fu took the field in support of Prince of Yan Di's northern campaign.

sentences.zh: 贛州賊為亂，東川侯胡海充總兵官，普定侯陳桓、靖甯侯葉升為副將，討平之。

translations.literal: Bandits in Ganzhou made trouble; Marquis of Dongchuan Hu Haichong was made commander-in-chief, with Marquis of Puding Chen Huan and Marquis of Jingning Ye Sheng as lieutenant generals, and they campaigned and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: Outlaws in Ganzhou rose in rebellion; Marquis of Dongchuan Hu Haichong was appointed commander-in-chief, with Marquis of Puding Chen Huan and Marquis of Jingning Ye Sheng as his deputies, and together they suppressed the disturbance.

sentences.zh: 唐勝宗督貴州各衛屯田。

translations.literal: Tang Shengzong supervised military-agricultural colonies in the various guards of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Shengzong oversaw garrison farming in the Guizhou guards.

sentences.zh: 二月戊申，藍玉討平西番叛蠻。

translations.literal: Second month, wushen: Lan Yu campaigned and pacified the rebellious western barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the wushen day, Lan Yu crushed the rebel tribes of the western frontier.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，耕耤田。

translations.literal: On bingchen, he plowed the sacred plot.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, the emperor plowed the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，河決歸德，發諸軍民塞之。

translations.literal: On guihai, the river burst its banks at Guide; troops and civilians were mobilized to block it.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, the Yellow River broke through at Guide, and soldiers and civilians were called up to seal the breach.

sentences.zh: 三月癸巳，燕王棣師次迤都，咬住等降。

translations.literal: Third month, guisi: Prince of Yan Di's army halted at Yidu; Yaqushili and the others surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the guisi day, Prince of Yan Di's army reached Yidu, and Yaqushili and his followers submitted.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，吉安侯陸仲亨等坐胡惟庸黨下獄。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month: Marquis of Ji'an Lu Zhongheng and others, as associates of Hu Weiyong's faction, were imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, Marquis of Ji'an Lu Zhongheng and others were thrown into prison on charges of belonging to Hu Weiyong's party.

sentences.zh: 丙申，潭王梓自焚死。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Prince of Tan Zi burned himself to death.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, Prince of Tan Zi died by self-immolation.

sentences.zh: 閏月丙子，藍玉平施南、忠建叛蠻。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, bingzi: Lan Yu pacified the rebellious tribes of Shinan and Zhongjian.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the bingzi day, Lan Yu subdued the rebel tribes of Shinan and Zhongjian.

sentences.zh: 五月甲午，遣諸公侯還裏，賜金幣有差。

translations.literal: Fifth month, jiawu: the various dukes and marquises were sent back to their home districts, and gold and coin were bestowed in differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the jiawu day, the great nobles were dismissed to their estates, each receiving gold and cash according to rank.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，賜太師韓國公李善長死，陸仲亨等皆坐誅。

translations.literal: On yimao, Grand Preceptor Duke of Han Li Shanchang was granted death; Lu Zhongheng and the rest were all put to death for their crimes.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, Grand Preceptor Duke of Han Li Shanchang was sentenced to suicide; Lu Zhongheng and the others were executed.

sentences.zh: 作《昭示奸黨錄》，佈告天下。

translations.literal: The Record for the Exposure of Treacherous Factions was compiled and proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: The court compiled the Record for the Exposure of Treacherous Factions and published it empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 六月乙丑，藍玉遣鳳翔侯張龍平都勻、散毛諸蠻。

translations.literal: Sixth month, yichou: Lan Yu sent Marquis of Fengxiang Zhang Long to pacify the tribes of Duyun, Sanmao, and the rest.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the yichou day, Lan Yu dispatched Marquis of Fengxiang Zhang Long to bring the tribes of Duyun, Sanmao, and neighboring districts under control.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，授耆民有才德知典故者官。

translations.literal: On gengyin, worthy elders of talent, virtue, and knowledge of precedent were given office.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, respected elders distinguished for ability, character, and learning in state precedent were appointed to office.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬辰，河決開封，振之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, renchen: the river burst its banks at Kaifeng; relief was provided.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the renchen day, the river broke through at Kaifeng, and relief was ordered.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，崇明、海門風雨海溢，遣官振之，發民二十五萬築堤。

translations.literal: On guisi, wind and rain at Chongming and Haimen caused the sea to overflow; officials were dispatched to provide relief, and 250,000 civilians were mobilized to build dikes.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, storms at Chongming and Haimen drove the sea over the land; officials were sent to organize relief, and a quarter of a million people were called up to raise embankments.

sentences.zh: 八月壬申，詔毋以吏卒充選舉。

translations.literal: Eighth month, renshen: an edict forbade filling civil-service quotas with clerks and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the renshen day, an edict barred clerks and common soldiers from being used to satisfy examination quotas.

sentences.zh: 藍玉還。

translations.literal: Lan Yu returned.
translations.idiomatic: Lan Yu returned to court.

sentences.zh: 是月，振河南、北平、山東水災。

translations.literal: That month, flood relief was provided in Henan, Beiping, and Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: That month, aid was extended to the flood-stricken provinces of Henan, Beiping, and Shandong.

sentences.zh: 九月庚寅朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, gengyin, first day of the month: there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the ninth month, gengyin, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己卯，振湖廣饑。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, jimao: famine relief was provided in Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the jimao day, famine relief was ordered for Huguang.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸丑，免山東被災田租。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, guichou: land rent was remitted in Shandong for fields stricken by disaster.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the guichou day, field rents were waived in Shandong for lands ruined by disaster.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸亥，令殊死以下囚輸粟北邊自贖。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, guihai: prisoners below the death penalty were ordered to pay grain on the northern frontier to redeem themselves.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the guihai day, convicts short of capital punishment were allowed to deliver grain to the northern border in exchange for release.

sentences.zh: 壬申，罷天下歲織文綺。

translations.literal: On renshen, the realm's annual weaving of patterned silks was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, the empire-wide yearly levy of figured silks was ended.

sentences.zh: 是年，墨刺、哈梅裏、高麗、占城、真臘、琉球、暹羅入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Meile, Hami, Korea, Champa, Zhenla, Ryukyu, and Siam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, embassies arrived from Meile, Hami, Korea, Champa, Zhenla, Ryukyu, and Siam.

sentences.zh: 二十四年春正月癸卯，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: Twenty-fourth year, spring, first month, guimao: Heaven and Earth were greatly sacrificed to at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, on the guimao day of the first month of spring, the emperor offered the great joint sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the southern altar.

sentences.zh: 戊申，潁國公傅友德為征虜將軍，定遠侯王弼、武定侯郭英副之，備北平邊。

translations.literal: On wushen, Duke of Ying Fu Youde was made General for the Campaign against the Barbarians, with Marquis of Dingyuan Wang Bi and Marquis of Wuding Guo Ying as his deputies, to guard the Beiping frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, Duke of Ying Fu Youde was appointed general for the campaign against the barbarians, with Marquis of Dingyuan Wang Bi and Marquis of Wuding Guo Ying as his lieutenants, to secure the Beiping border.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，免山東田租。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Shandong land rent was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, field rents were waived in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 二月壬申，耕耤田。

translations.literal: Second month, renshen: he plowed the sacred plot.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the renshen day, the emperor plowed the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 三月戊子朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Third month, wuzi, first day of the month: there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the third month, wuzi, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 魏國公徐輝祖、曹國公李景隆、涼國公藍玉等備邊陝西。

translations.literal: Duke of Wei Xu Huizu, Duke of Cao Li Jinglong, Duke of Liang Lan Yu, and others prepared the Shaanxi frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Wei Xu Huizu, Duke of Cao Li Jinglong, Duke of Liang Lan Yu, and others took charge of defenses along the Shaanxi frontier.

sentences.zh: 乙未，靖甯侯葉升練兵甘肅。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Marquis of Jingning Ye Sheng drilled troops in Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, Marquis of Jingning Ye Sheng conducted military training in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，賜許觀等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Xu Guan and the other jinshi were granted metropolitan degree and provincial origin in differing ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, Xu Guan and the other examination graduates received metropolitan degrees and provincial appointments according to rank.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛未，封皇子旃為慶王，權甯王，楩岷王，橞谷王，松韓王，模王，楹安王，桱唐王，棟郢王，彝伊王。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, xinwei: the princes were enfeoffed—Zhi as Prince of Qing, Quan as Prince of Ning, Fan as Prince of Min, Hui as Prince of Gu, Song as Prince of Han, Mo as prince, Ying as Prince of An, Jing as Prince of Tang, Dong as Prince of Ying, and Ru as Prince of Yi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the xinwei day, the princes received their titles: Zhi became Prince of Qing, Quan Prince of Ning, Fan Prince of Min, Hui Prince of Gu, Song Prince of Han, Mo a princely fief, Ying Prince of An, Jing Prince of Tang, Dong Prince of Ying, and Ru Prince of Yi.

sentences.zh: 癸未，燕王棣督傅友德諸將出塞，敗敵而還。

translations.literal: On guiwei, Prince of Yan Di supervised Fu Youde and the other generals in a sortie beyond the passes, defeated the enemy, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, Prince of Yan Di led Fu Youde and the other commanders beyond the frontier, routed the foe, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 五月戊戌，漢、衛、谷、慶、寧、岷六王練兵臨清。

translations.literal: Fifth month, wuxu: the six princes of Han, Wei, Gu, Qing, Ning, and Min drilled troops at Linqing.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the wuxu day, the princes of Han, Wei, Gu, Qing, Ning, and Min trained troops at Linqing.

sentences.zh: 六月己未，詔廷臣參考歷代禮制，更定冠服、居室、器用制度。

translations.literal: Sixth month, jiwei: an edict ordered court ministers to consult the ritual systems of successive dynasties and revise regulations for caps and robes, dwellings, and utensils.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the jiwei day, the emperor commanded his ministers to study the ceremonial codes of past dynasties and redraw the rules governing dress, housing, and household goods.

sentences.zh: 甲子，久旱錄囚。

translations.literal: On jiazi, because of prolonged drought, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, after a long drought, criminal cases were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚子，徙富民實京師。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, gengzi: wealthy households were moved to fill out the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the gengzi day, prosperous families were resettled to bolster the capital.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，免畿內官田租之半。

translations.literal: On xinchou, half of official-field rent within the metropolitan districts was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, half the rents on government lands in the capital region were waived.

sentences.zh: 八月乙卯，秦王樉有罪，召還京師。

translations.literal: Eighth month, yimao: Prince of Qin Shu was guilty of a crime and was summoned back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the yimao day, Prince of Qin Shu was found guilty and recalled to the capital.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，皇太子巡撫陝西。

translations.literal: On yichou, the crown prince toured and pacified Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, the crown prince made an inspection tour through Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，都督僉事劉真、宋晟討哈梅裏，敗之。

translations.literal: On yihai, Regional Commander Liu Zhen and Song Sheng campaigned against Hami and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, Regional Commander Liu Zhen and Song Sheng marched against Hami and won a victory.

sentences.zh: 九月乙酉，遣使諭西域。

translations.literal: Ninth month, yiyou: envoys were dispatched to instruct the Western Regions.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the yiyou day, ambassadors were sent to announce the court's will to the Western Regions.

sentences.zh: 是月，倭寇雷州，百戶李玉、鎮撫陶鼎戰死。

translations.literal: That month, Japanese pirates raided Leizhou; Centurion Li Yu and Garrison Commander Tao Ding were killed in battle.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Japanese raiders struck Leizhou, and Centurion Li Yu and Garrison Commander Tao Ding fell fighting.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁巳，免北平、河間被水田租。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, dingsi: land rent was remitted in Beiping and Hejian for fields ruined by flood.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the dingsi day, field rents were waived in Beiping and Hejian for waterlogged lands.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲午，五開蠻叛，都督僉事茅鼎討平之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, jiawu: the tribes of Wukai rebelled; Regional Commander Mao Ding campaigned and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the jiawu day, the Wukai tribes rose in revolt, and Regional Commander Mao Ding marched against them and restored order.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，皇太子還京師，晉王來朝。

translations.literal: On gengxu, the crown prince returned to the capital, and Prince of Jin Gang came to audience.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, the crown prince came back to the capital, and Prince of Jin Gang presented himself at court.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，振河南水災。

translations.literal: On xinhai, flood relief was provided in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, flood relief was ordered for Henan.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚午，周王橚復國。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, gengwu: Prince of Zhou Shu's fief was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the gengwu day, Prince of Zhou Shu's princedom was reinstated.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，阿資復叛，都督僉事何福討降之。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Azi again rebelled; Regional Commander He Fu campaigned and made him submit.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, Azi rose again in rebellion, and Regional Commander He Fu forced his surrender.

sentences.zh: 是年，天下郡縣賦役黃冊成，計戶千六十八萬四千四百三十五，丁五千六百七十七萬四千五百六十一。

translations.literal: That year, the yellow registers of tax and corvée for all commanderies and counties were completed, tallying 10,684,435 households and 56,774,561 adult males.
translations.idiomatic: That year, the empire completed its yellow registers of tax and labor obligations, recording 10,684,435 households and 56,774,561 adult males.

sentences.zh: 琉球、暹羅、別失八里、撒馬兒罕入貢。

translations.literal: Ryukyu, Siam, Beshbaligh, and Samarkand sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, embassies arrived from Ryukyu, Siam, Beshbaligh, and Samarkand.

sentences.zh: 以占城有篡逆事，卻之。

translations.literal: Because Champa had committed regicide and treason, its tribute was refused.
translations.idiomatic: When Champa was found guilty of usurpation and treason, its embassy was turned away.

sentences.zh: 二十五年春正月戊子，周王橚來朝，庚寅，河決陽武，發軍民塞之，免被水田租。

translations.literal: Twenty-fifth year, spring, first month, wuzi: Prince of Zhou Shu came to audience; on gengyin the river burst its banks at Yangwu, troops and civilians were mobilized to block it, and land rent was remitted for flooded fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year, on the wuzi day of the first month of spring, Prince of Zhou Shu came to court; on the gengyin day the Yellow River broke through at Yangwu, soldiers and civilians were called up to seal the breach, and field rents were waived on inundated lands.

sentences.zh: 乙未，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Heaven and Earth were greatly sacrificed to at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, the emperor offered the great joint sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the southern altar.

sentences.zh: 何福討都勻、畢節諸蠻，平之。

translations.literal: He Fu campaigned against the tribes of Duyun, Bijie, and the rest, and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: He Fu marched against the tribes of Duyun, Bijie, and neighboring districts and brought them under control.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，令死困輸粟塞十。

translations.literal: On xinchou, death-row prisoners were ordered to pay grain on the northern frontier.
