translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, prisoners under sentence of death were permitted to redeem themselves by delivering grain to the northern border.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，晉王、燕王棣、楚王楨、湘王柏來朝。

translations.literal: On renyin, Prince of Jin Gang, Prince of Yan Di, Prince of Chu Zhen, and Prince of Xiang Bai came to audience.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, Prince of Jin Gang, Prince of Yan Di, Prince of Chu Zhen, and Prince of Xiang Bai presented themselves at court.

sentences.zh: 二月戊午，召曹國公李景隆等還京師。

translations.literal: Second month, wuwu: Duke of Cao Li Jinglong and the others were summoned back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the wuwu day, Duke of Cao Li Jinglong and the others were recalled to the capital.

sentences.zh: 靖甯侯葉升等練兵於河南及臨、鞏、甘、涼、延慶。

translations.literal: Marquis of Jingning Ye Sheng and the others drilled troops in Henan and at Lin, Gong, Gan, Liang, and Yanqing.
translations.idiomatic: Marquis of Jingning Ye Sheng and his colleagues conducted military training in Henan and at Lin, Gong, Gan, Liang, and Yanqing.

sentences.zh: 都督茅鼎等平五開蠻。

translations.literal: Regional Commander Mao Ding and the others pacified the Wukai tribes.
translations.idiomatic: Regional Commander Mao Ding and his officers subdued the Wukai tribes.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，耕耤田。

translations.literal: On bingyin, he plowed the sacred plot.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, the emperor plowed the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔天下衛所軍以十之七屯田。

translations.literal: On gengchen, an edict ordered that seven-tenths of the troops in guards and posts throughout the realm should farm garrison lands.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, an edict required that seven out of every ten soldiers in the empire's guards and garrisons devote themselves to military farming.

sentences.zh: 三月癸未，馮勝等十四人分理陝西、山西、河南諸衛軍務。

translations.literal: Third month, guiwei: Feng Sheng and thirteen others were assigned separately to administer military affairs in the guards of Shaanxi, Shanxi, and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the guiwei day, Feng Sheng and thirteen colleagues were dispatched to take charge of military affairs in the Shaanxi, Shanxi, and Henan guards.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，改封豫王桂為代王，漢王楧為肅王，衛王植為遼王。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Prince of Yu Gui was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Dai, Prince of Han Zhu as Prince of Su, and Prince of Wei Zhi as Prince of Liao.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, Prince of Yu Gui was transferred to the title Prince of Dai, Prince of Han Zhu to Prince of Su, and Prince of Wei Zhi to Prince of Liao.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚辰，秦王樉復國。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, gengchen: Prince of Qin Shu's fief was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the gengchen day, Prince of Qin Shu's princedom was reinstated.

sentences.zh: 癸未，指揮瞿能敗月魯帖木兒於雙狼寨。

translations.literal: On guiwei, Commander Qu Neng defeated Yue Lu Tiemur at Shuanglang Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, Commander Qu Neng routed Yue Lu Tiemur at Shuanglang Stockade.

sentences.zh: 八月己未，江夏侯周德興坐事誅。

translations.literal: Eighth month, jiwei: Marquis of Jiangxia Zhou Dexing was put to death for his crimes.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the jiwei day, Marquis of Jiangxia Zhou Dexing was executed for his offenses.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，馮勝、傅友德帥開國公常升等分行山西，籍民為軍，屯田於大同、東勝，立十六衛。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Feng Sheng and Fu Youde led Founding Duke Chang Sheng and the others in separate columns through Shanxi, registering the people as soldiers and establishing military-agricultural colonies at Datong and Dongsheng, where sixteen guards were set up.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, Feng Sheng and Fu Youde led Founding Duke Chang Sheng and others through Shanxi in separate divisions, enrolling the populace as troops and opening garrison farms at Datong and Dongsheng, where sixteen guards were established.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，給公侯歲祿，歸賜田於官。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, the dukes and marquises were granted annual stipends, and their bestowed fields were returned to the state.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, the great nobles received yearly salaries, and the lands earlier granted them were surrendered back to the government.

sentences.zh: 丙子，靖甯侯葉升坐胡惟庸黨誅。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Marquis of Jingning Ye Sheng was put to death as a member of Hu Weiyong's faction.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, Marquis of Jingning Ye Sheng was executed as an associate of Hu Weiyong's party.

sentences.zh: 九月庚寅，立皇孫允炆為皇太孫，高麗李成桂幽其主瑤而自立，以國人表來請命，詔聽之，更其國號曰朝鮮。

translations.literal: Ninth month, gengyin: the emperor's grandson Yunwen was established as heir apparent to the heir apparent; in Korea, Yi Seong-gye imprisoned his lord Yo and made himself ruler, and with a memorial from his people requesting investiture, an edict approved it and changed the state's name to Joseon.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the gengyin day, the emperor's grandson Yunwen was named heir apparent to the crown prince; in Korea, Yi Seong-gye deposed King Yo and seized power, and when his subjects petitioned for imperial confirmation, the court assented and renamed the kingdom Joseon.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙亥，沐春襲封西平侯，鎮雲南。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, yihai: Mu Chun succeeded to the marquisate of Xiping and garrisoned Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the yihai day, Mu Chun inherited the marquisate of Xiping and took command in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲午，藍玉擒月魯帖木兒，誅之，召玉還。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, jiawu: Lan Yu captured Yue Lu Tiemur and executed him, then was recalled.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the jiawu day, Lan Yu seized Yue Lu Tiemur and put him to death, then was summoned back to court.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌，宋國公馮勝、潁國公傅友德等兼東宮師保官。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, jiaxu: Duke of Song Feng Sheng, Duke of Ying Fu Youde, and the others concurrently held Eastern Palace tutor and guardian posts.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the jiaxu day, Duke of Song Feng Sheng, Duke of Ying Fu Youde, and the others were given additional appointments as tutors and guardians of the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 閏月戊戌，馮勝為總兵官，傅友德副之，練兵山西、河南、兼領屯衛。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, wuxu: Feng Sheng was made commander-in-chief and Fu Youde his deputy; they drilled troops in Shanxi and Henan and also oversaw garrison colonies.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the wuxu day, Feng Sheng was appointed commander-in-chief with Fu Youde as his deputy to train forces in Shanxi and Henan while supervising the garrison farms.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球中山、山南、高麗，哈梅裏入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Ryukyu's Zhongshan and Shannan, Korea, and Hami sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, embassies arrived from Ryukyu's Zhongshan and Shannan domains, Korea, and Hami.

sentences.zh: 二十六年春正月戊申，免天下耆民來朝。

translations.literal: Twenty-sixth year, spring, first month, wushen: elders coming to court from throughout the realm were exempted from the journey.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year, on the wushen day of the first month of spring, respected elders summoned from across the empire were excused from traveling to court.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Heaven and Earth were greatly sacrificed to at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, the emperor offered the great joint sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the southern altar.

sentences.zh: 二月丁丑，晉王統山西、河南軍出塞，召馮勝、傅友德、常升、王弼等還。

translations.literal: Second month, dingchou: Prince of Jin Gang took command of the armies of Shanxi and Henan in a sortie beyond the passes; Feng Sheng, Fu Youde, Chang Sheng, Wang Bi, and the others were recalled.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the dingchou day, Prince of Jin Gang led the Shanxi and Henan forces beyond the frontier, while Feng Sheng, Fu Youde, Chang Sheng, Wang Bi, and the others were recalled to court.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，蜀王椿來朝。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Prince of Shu Chun came to audience.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, Prince of Shu Chun presented himself at court.

sentences.zh: 涼國公藍玉以謀反，並鶴慶侯張翼、普定侯陳桓、景川侯曹震、舳艫侯硃壽、東莞伯何榮、吏部尚書詹徽等皆坐誅。

translations.literal: On jichou, Duke of Liang Lan Yu was charged with plotting rebellion; Marquis of Heqing Zhang Yi, Marquis of Puding Chen Huan, Marquis of Jingchuan Cao Zhen, Marquis of Zhuanglu Zhu Shou, Baron of Dongguan He Rong, Minister of Personnel Zhan Hui, and the rest were all put to death for the crime.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, Duke of Liang Lan Yu was accused of treason; Marquis of Heqing Zhang Yi, Marquis of Puding Chen Huan, Marquis of Jingchuan Cao Zhen, Marquis of Zhuanglu Zhu Shou, Baron of Dongguan He Rong, Minister of Personnel Zhan Hui, and their associates were executed with him.

sentences.zh: 己丑，頒《逆臣錄》於天下。

translations.literal: On jichou, the Record of Rebellious Ministers was promulgated throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, the Record of Rebellious Ministers was published empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，耕耤田。

translations.literal: On gengyin, he plowed the sacred plot.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, the emperor plowed the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 三月辛亥，代王桂率護衛兵出塞，聽晉王節制。

translations.literal: Third month, xinhai: Prince of Dai Gui led his guard troops beyond the passes, subject to Prince of Jin's command.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the xinhai day, Prince of Dai Gui marched beyond the frontier at the head of his guard, under the orders of Prince of Jin.

sentences.zh: 長興侯耿炳文練兵陝西。

translations.literal: Marquis of Changxing Geng Bingwen drilled troops in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Marquis of Changxing Geng Bingwen conducted military training in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，馮勝、傅友德備邊山西、北平，其屬衛將校悉聽晉王、燕王節制。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Feng Sheng and Fu Youde prepared the Shanxi and Beiping frontiers; the guard officers under them were all placed under the command of the Princes of Jin and Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, Feng Sheng and Fu Youde took charge of the Shanxi and Beiping defenses, and every subordinate officer in their guards was made subject to the Princes of Jin and Yan.

sentences.zh: 庚申，詔二王軍務大者始以聞。

translations.literal: On gengshen, an edict ordered that only major military affairs of the two princes need first be reported.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, an edict ruled that the two princes need report to the throne only on weighty military matters.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，會甯侯張溫坐藍玉黨誅。

translations.literal: On renxu, Marquis of Huining Zhang Wen, implicated in the Lan Yu faction, was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, Marquis of Huining Zhang Wen was put to death as an associate of Lan Yu's faction.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙亥，孝感饑，遣使乘傳發倉貸之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, yihai: Xiaogan suffered famine; envoys were dispatched by urgent relay to open the granaries and loan grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the yihai day, Xiaogan was stricken by famine, and envoys were sent post-haste to open the public granaries and issue grain loans.

sentences.zh: 詔自今遇歲饑，先貸後聞，著為令。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that from this time, when any year brought famine, grain was to be loaned first and reported afterward; this was established as regulation.
translations.idiomatic: An edict decreed that whenever famine struck, local officials must issue relief grain first and report afterward, and the rule was written into law.

sentences.zh: 戊子，周王橚來朝。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Prince of Zhou Su came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, Prince of Zhou Su presented himself at court.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，旱，詔群臣直言得失，省獄囚。

translations.literal: On gengyin, there was drought; an edict ordered the ministers to speak plainly of gains and losses, and prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, drought hardened across the realm; the emperor commanded his ministers to speak plainly of what the government was doing right and wrong, and ordered a review of prisoners.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以安南擅廢立，絕其朝貢。

translations.literal: On bingshen, because Annam had arbitrarily deposed and enthroned rulers, its tributary missions were cut off.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, because Annam had deposed and enthroned rulers on its own authority, the court severed its tributary relations.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲辰朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, jiachen, first day of the month: there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the seventh month of autumn, jiachen, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 戊申，選秀才張宗浚等隨詹事府官分直文華殿，侍皇太孫。

translations.literal: On wushen, the xiucai Zhang Zongjun and others were selected to rotate duty in the Hall of Literary Glory with officials of the Household of the Heir Apparent, attending the imperial grandson.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, licentiates including Zhang Zongjun were chosen to serve in rotating watches in the Hall of Literary Glory alongside the heir apparent's household, attending the imperial grandson.

sentences.zh: 八月，秦、晉、燕、周、齊五王來朝。

translations.literal: Eighth month: the five princes of Qin, Jin, Yan, Zhou, and Qi came to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, the princes of Qin, Jin, Yan, Zhou, and Qi all presented themselves at court.

sentences.zh: 九月癸丑，代、肅、遼、慶、甯五王來朝。

translations.literal: Ninth month, guichou: the five princes of Dai, Su, Liao, Qing, and Ning came to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the guichou day, the princes of Dai, Su, Liao, Qing, and Ning all came to court.

sentences.zh: 赦胡惟庸、藍玉餘黨。

translations.literal: The remaining parties of Hu Weiyong and Lan Yu were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Survivors of the Hu Weiyong and Lan Yu factions were granted amnesty.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙申，擢國子監生六十四人為布政使等官。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, bingshen: sixty-four students of the Imperial Academy were promoted to provincial administration commissioners and the like.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the bingshen day, sixty-four Imperial Academy students were elevated to posts including provincial administration commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十二月，頒《永鑒錄》於諸王。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: the Eternal Mirror Record was issued to all the princes.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, the Eternal Mirror Record was distributed to every prince.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球、爪哇、暹羅入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Ryukyu, Java, and Siam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, embassies arrived from Ryukyu, Java, and Siam.

sentences.zh: 二十七年春正月乙卯，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: Twenty-seventh year, spring, first month, yimao: Heaven and Earth were greatly sacrificed to at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, on the yimao day of the first month of spring, the emperor offered the great joint sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the southern altar.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，李景隆為平羌將軍，鎮甘肅。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Li Jinglong was made Pacification General of the West and garrisoned Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, Li Jinglong was appointed pacification general of the west and stationed in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 發天下倉谷貸貧民。

translations.literal: Granaries throughout the realm were opened to loan grain to the poor.
translations.idiomatic: Public granaries across the empire were opened to lend grain to the poor.

sentences.zh: 三月庚子，賜張信等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: Third month, gengzi: Zhang Xin and other jinshi were granted, with differences in rank, the titles of Presented Scholar and Advanced Scholar.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the gengzi day, Zhang Xin and the other jinshi were conferred, according to rank, the titles of Presented Scholar and Advanced Scholar.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，魏國公徐輝祖、安陸侯吳傑備倭浙江。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Duke of Wei Xu Hui and Marquis of Anlu Wu Jie prepared defenses against Japanese pirates in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, Duke of Wei Xu Hui and Marquis of Anlu Wu Jie were assigned to organize coastal defenses against Japanese raiders in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，課民樹桑棗木棉。

translations.literal: On gengxu, the people were charged to plant mulberry, jujube, and cotton.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, the populace was ordered to plant mulberry, jujube, and cotton.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以四方底平，收藏甲兵，示不復用。

translations.literal: On jiazi, because the four quarters were settled, arms and armor were stored away to show they would not be used again.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, with peace secured on every frontier, weapons and armor were put into storage as a sign that the realm would fight no more.

sentences.zh: 秋八月甲戌，吳傑及永定侯張銓率致仕武臣，備倭廣東。

translations.literal: Autumn, eighth month, jiaxu: Wu Jie and Marquis of Yongding Zhang Quan led retired military officers to prepare against Japanese pirates in Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on the jiaxu day, Wu Jie and Marquis of Yongding Zhang Quan led retired military officials to organize coastal defense against Japanese raiders in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，遣國子監生分行天下。

translations.literal: On yihai, Imperial Academy students were dispatched separately throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, Imperial Academy students were sent out in separate circuits across the empire.

sentences.zh: 督吏民修水利。

translations.literal: Officials and commoners were overseen in repairing waterworks.
translations.idiomatic: Officials and commoners were set to repairing canals and dikes.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，階、文軍亂，都督甯正為平羌將軍討之。

translations.literal: On bingxu, the armies of Jie and Wen rebelled; Commander-in-chief Ning Zheng was made Pacification General of the West to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, the garrisons of Jie and Wen rose in mutiny, and Ning Zheng was named pacification general of the west to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 九月，徐輝祖節制陝西沿邊諸軍。

translations.literal: Ninth month: Xu Hui took command of all the armies along the Shaanxi frontier.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Xu Hui was placed in overall command of the forces along the Shaanxi frontier.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月乙丑，潁國公傅友德坐事誅。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, yichou: Duke of Ying Fu Youde, guilty of an offense, was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on the yichou day, Duke of Ying Fu Youde was put to death for his offenses.

sentences.zh: 阿資復叛，西平侯沐春擊敗之。

translations.literal: Azi rebelled again; Marquis of Xiping Mu Chun attacked and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Azi rose in rebellion once more, and Marquis of Xiping Mu Chun routed his forces.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙亥，定遠侯王弼坐事誅。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, yihai: Marquis of Dingyuan Wang Bi, guilty of an offense, was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the yihai day, Marquis of Dingyuan Wang Bi was put to death for his offenses.

sentences.zh: 是年，烏斯藏、琉球、緬、朵甘、爪哇、撒馬兒罕、朝鮮入貢。

translations.literal: That year, U-Tsang, Ryukyu, Burma, Dokham, Java, Samarkand, and Korea sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, embassies arrived from U-Tsang, Ryukyu, Burma, Dokham, Java, Samarkand, and Korea.

sentences.zh: 安南來貢，卻之。

translations.literal: Annam came to offer tribute; it was refused.
translations.idiomatic: An embassy from Annam offered tribute, but the court turned it away.

sentences.zh: 二十八年春正月丙午，階、文寇平，甯正以兵從秦王樉征洮州叛番。

translations.literal: Twenty-eighth year, spring, first month, bingwu: the bandits of Jie and Wen were pacified; Ning Zheng followed Prince of Qin Shuang with troops to campaign against the rebellious Tibetans of Taozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year, on the bingwu day of the first month of spring, the rebels of Jie and Wen were subdued; Ning Zheng marched under Prince of Qin Shuang against the rebellious Tibetan bands of Taozhou.

sentences.zh: 丁未，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Heaven and Earth were greatly sacrificed to at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, the emperor offered the great joint sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the southern altar.

sentences.zh: 甲子，西平侯沐春擒斬阿資，越州平。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Marquis of Xiping Mu Chun captured and executed Azi; Yuezhou was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, Marquis of Xiping Mu Chun captured and executed Azi, and Yuezhou was brought under control.

sentences.zh: 是月，周王橚、晉王、率河南、山西諸衛軍出塞，築城屯田。

translations.literal: That month, Prince of Zhou Su and Prince of Jin Gang led the guard armies of Henan and Shanxi beyond the frontier to build forts and undertake military colonies.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Prince of Zhou Su and Prince of Jin Gang led the Henan and Shanxi guard armies beyond the frontier to build fortified posts and open garrison farms.

sentences.zh: 燕王棣帥總兵官周興出遼東塞。

translations.literal: Prince of Yan Di marched with the commander-in-chief Zhou Xing out through the Liaodong passes.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Yan Di took the field with Commander-in-Chief Zhou Xing beyond the Liaodong frontier.

sentences.zh: 二月丁卯，宋國公馮勝坐事誅。

translations.literal: Second month, dingmao: Duke of Song Feng Sheng, guilty of an offense, was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the dingmao day, Duke of Song Feng Sheng was put to death for his offenses.

sentences.zh: 己丑，諭戶部編民百戶為裏。

translations.literal: On jichou, the Ministry of Revenue was instructed to organize the populace in units of one hundred households per li.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, the Ministry of Revenue was instructed to register the populace in communities of one hundred households each.

sentences.zh: 婚姻死喪疾病患難，里中富者助財，貧者助力。

translations.literal: In weddings, funerals, sickness, or hardship, the wealthy in each li were to assist with funds and the poor with labor.
translations.idiomatic: For weddings, funerals, sickness, or hardship, the wealthy in each community were to help with money and the poor with labor.

sentences.zh: 春秋耕獲，通力合作，以教民睦。

translations.literal: In spring and autumn planting and harvest, all were to labor together, to teach the people mutual regard.
translations.idiomatic: At spring planting and autumn harvest, all were to work together, to teach the people neighborly solidarity.

sentences.zh: 夏六月壬申，詔諸土司皆立儒學。

translations.literal: Summer, sixth month, renshen: an edict ordered every native office to establish Confucian schools.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of summer, on the renshen day, an edict commanded every native office to establish Confucian schools.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，周興等自開原追敵至甫答迷城，不及而還。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Zhou Xing and the others pursued the enemy from Kaiyuan as far as Foudami city but failed to overtake them and returned.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, Zhou Xing and his men pursued the enemy from Kaiyuan to Foudami city, failed to overtake them, and turned back.

sentences.zh: 己丑，禦奉天門，諭群臣曰：「朕起兵至今四十餘年，灼見情偽，懲創奸頑或法外用刑，本非常典。

translations.literal: On jichou, he addressed the ministers at the Gate of Receiving Heaven, saying: "From the time I raised the army until now, more than forty years, I have clearly seen what is false and what is true; in punishing the crafty and stubborn I have sometimes applied punishments outside the law—this was never a normal statute.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, the emperor took his seat at the Gate of Receiving Heaven and addressed his ministers: "From the day I raised my banners until now, more than forty years have passed. I have seen clearly who is false and who is true. In breaking the crafty and stubborn I have sometimes imposed punishments outside the Code—never as ordinary law.

sentences.zh: 後嗣止頒《律》與《大誥》，不許用黥剌、剕、劓、閹割之刑。

translations.literal: My successors shall issue only the Code and the Great Admonitions, and shall not employ tattooing, nose-cutting, hamstringing, ear-cutting, or castration.
translations.idiomatic: My successors shall issue only the Code and the Great Admonitions, and shall not employ tattooing, nose-cutting, hamstringing, ear-cutting, or castration.

sentences.zh: 臣下敢以請者，置重典。

translations.literal: Any subject who dares request such punishments shall be visited with severe penalty.
translations.idiomatic: Any subject who dares request such punishments shall be visited with severe penalty.

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「朕罷丞相，設府、部、都察院分理庶政，事權歸於朝廷。

translations.literal: " He also said: "I abolished the chancellor, established the offices, ministries, and Censorate to handle civil affairs separately, and returned all authority to the court.
translations.idiomatic: " He also said: "I abolished the chancellor, established the offices, ministries, and Censorate to divide civil affairs among them, and returned all authority to the court.

sentences.zh: 嗣君不許復立丞相。

translations.literal: My successor shall not reestablish the office of chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: My successor shall not reestablish the office of chancellor.

sentences.zh: 臣下敢以請者置重典。

translations.literal: Any subject who dares request it shall be visited with severe penalty.
translations.idiomatic: Any subject who dares request it shall be visited with severe penalty.

sentences.zh: 皇親惟謀逆不赦。

translations.literal: Imperial kinsmen shall be spared only for treason.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial kinsmen shall be spared only for treason.

sentences.zh: 余罪，宗親會議取上裁。

translations.literal: For all other crimes, the clan assembly shall deliberate and submit the outcome to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: For all other crimes, the clan assembly shall deliberate and submit the outcome to the throne.

sentences.zh: 法司只許舉奏，毋得擅逮。

translations.literal: The judicial offices may only present accusations; they shall not arrest on their own authority.
translations.idiomatic: The judicial offices may only present accusations; they shall not arrest on their own authority.

sentences.zh: 勒諸典章，永為遵守。」

translations.literal: These provisions are to be carved into the statutes and obeyed forever."
translations.idiomatic: These provisions are to be carved into the statutes and obeyed forever."

sentences.zh: 秋八月丁卯，都督楊文為征南將軍，指揮韓觀、都督僉事宋晟副之，討龍州士官趙宗壽。

translations.literal: Autumn, eighth month, dingmao: Commander Yang Wen was made Southern Campaigning General, with Commander Han Guan and Vice Commander Song Sheng as his deputies, to campaign against the native officer Zhao Zongshou of Long Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on the dingmao day, Commander Yang Wen was appointed southern campaigning general, with Commander Han Guan and Vice Commander Song Sheng as his deputies, to campaign against the native officer Zhao Zongshou of Long Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，信國公湯和卒。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Duke of Xin Tang He died.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, Duke of Xin Tang He died.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，趙宗壽伏罪來朝，楊文移兵討奉議、南丹叛蠻。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Zhao Zongshou confessed his crimes and came to court; Yang Wen shifted his troops to suppress the rebellious tribes of Fengyi and Nandan.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, Zhao Zongshou confessed his crimes and came to court; Yang Wen shifted his troops to suppress the rebellious tribes of Fengyi and Nandan.

sentences.zh: 九月丁酉，免畿內、山東秋糧。

translations.literal: Ninth month, dingyou: autumn grain taxes were remitted in the metropolitan districts and Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the dingyou day, autumn grain taxes were waived in the metropolitan districts and Shandong.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，頒《皇明祖訓條章》於中外，「後世有言更祖制者，以奸臣論」。

translations.literal: On gengxu, the Ancestral Instructions and Regulations was issued throughout the realm, with the warning: "Whoever in later ages speaks of altering the ancestral institutions shall be deemed a traitorous minister."
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, the Ancestral Instructions and Regulations was issued throughout the realm, with the warning: "Whoever in later ages speaks of altering the ancestral institutions shall be deemed a traitorous minister."

sentences.zh: 十一月乙亥，奉議、南丹蠻悉平。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, yihai: the tribes of Fengyi and Nandan were entirely pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the yihai day, the tribes of Fengyi and Nandan were entirely pacified.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬辰，詔河南、山東桑棗及二十七年後新墾田，毋徵稅。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, renchen: an edict declared that mulberry, jujube, and newly opened fields in Henan and Shandong since the twenty-seventh year would not be taxed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the renchen day, an edict declared that mulberry, jujube, and newly opened fields in Henan and Shandong since the twenty-seventh year would not be taxed.

sentences.zh: 是年，朝鮮、琉球、暹羅入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Korea, Ryukyu, and Siam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, embassies arrived from Korea, Ryukyu, and Siam.

sentences.zh: 二十九年春正月壬申，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: Twenty-ninth year, spring, first month, renshen: Heaven and Earth were greatly sacrificed to at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year, on the renshen day of the first month of spring, the emperor offered the great joint sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the southern altar.

sentences.zh: 二月癸卯，征虜前將軍胡冕討郴、桂蠻，平之。

translations.literal: Second month, guimao: former Pacification General of the North Hu Mian campaigned against the tribes of Chen and Gui and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the guimao day, former northern pacification general Hu Mian campaigned against the tribes of Chen and Gui and restored order.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，燕王棣帥師巡大寧，周世子有燉帥師巡北平關隘。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Prince of Yan Di led troops on patrol in Daening; the heir of Zhou, Youdun, led troops on patrol at the passes of northern Ping.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, Prince of Yan Di led troops on patrol in Daening, while the Zhou heir Youdun inspected the passes of northern Ping.

sentences.zh: 三月辛酉，楚王楨、湘王柏來朝。

translations.literal: Third month, xinyou: Prince of Chu Zhen and Prince of Xiang Bai came to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the xinyou day, Prince of Chu Zhen and Prince of Xiang Bai presented themselves at court.

sentences.zh: 甲子，燕王敗敵於徹徹兒山，又追敗之於兀良哈禿城而還。

translations.literal: On jiazi, the Prince of Yan defeated the enemy at Cheche'er Mountain, pursued and defeated them again at Uliangha Tu city, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, the Prince of Yan routed the enemy at Cheche'er Mountain, pursued and routed them again at Uliangha Tu city, and returned.

sentences.zh: 秋八月丁未，免應天、太平五府田租。

translations.literal: Autumn, eighth month, dingwei: land rent in the five prefectures of Yingtian and Taiping was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on the dingwei day, field rents were waived in the five prefectures of Yingtian and Taiping.

sentences.zh: 九月乙亥，召致仕武臣二千五百餘人入朝，大賚之，各進秩一級。

translations.literal: Ninth month, yihai: more than 2,500 retired military officers were summoned to court, richly rewarded, and each advanced one rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the yihai day, more than twenty-five hundred retired military officers were summoned to court, granted lavish gifts, and each promoted one rank.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球、安南、朝鮮、烏斯茂入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Ryukyu, Annam, Korea, and U-Tsang sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, embassies arrived from Ryukyu, Annam, Korea, and U-Tsang.

sentences.zh: 三十年春正月丙辰，耿炳文為征西將軍，郭英副之，巡西北邊。

translations.literal: Thirtieth year, spring, first month, bingchen: Geng Bingwen was made Western Campaigning General, with Guo Ying as deputy, to inspect the northwest frontier.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year, on the bingchen day of the first month of spring, Geng Bingwen was appointed western campaigning general, with Guo Ying as his deputy, to inspect the northwest frontier.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Heaven and Earth were greatly sacrificed to at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, the emperor offered the great joint sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the southern altar.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，置行太僕寺於山西、北平、陝西、甘肅、遼東，掌馬政。

translations.literal: On dingmao, traveling offices of the Court of the Imperial Stud were established in Shanxi, northern Ping, Shaanxi, Gansu, and Liaodong to manage horse administration.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, traveling offices of the Court of the Imperial Stud were established in Shanxi, northern Ping, Shaanxi, Gansu, and Liaodong to manage the horse herds.

sentences.zh: 己巳，左都督楊文屯田遼東。

translations.literal: On jisi, Left Commander Yang Wen undertook military colonies in Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, Left Commander Yang Wen opened garrison farms in Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 是月，沔縣盜起，詔耿炳文討之。

translations.literal: That month, bandits rose in Mian County; an edict ordered Geng Bingwen to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: That month, outlaw bands rose in Mian County, and Geng Bingwen was ordered to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 二月庚寅，水西蠻叛，都督僉事顧成為征南將軍，討平之。

translations.literal: Second month, gengyin: the tribes of western Guizhou rebelled; Vice Commander Gu Cheng was made Southern Campaigning General and suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the gengyin day, the tribes of western Guizhou rose in revolt; Vice Commander Gu Cheng was named southern campaigning general, crushed the uprising, and restored order.

sentences.zh: 三月癸丑，賜陳安阝等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: Third month, guichou: Chen An and other jinshi were granted, with differences in rank, the titles of Presented Scholar and Advanced Scholar.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the guichou day, Chen An and the other jinshi were conferred, according to rank, the titles of Presented Scholar and Advanced Scholar.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，古州蠻叛，龍裏千戶吳得、鎮撫井孚戰死。

translations.literal: On gengchen, the tribes of Gu Prefecture rebelled; Qianhu Wu De of Longli and Pacification Commissioner Jing Fu died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, the tribes of Gu Prefecture rose in revolt; Qianhu Wu De of Longli and Pacification Commissioner Jing Fu were killed in action.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己亥，都指揮齊讓為平羌將軍，討之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, jihai: Commander Qi Rang was made Pacification General of the West to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the jihai day, Commander Qi Rang was named pacification general of the west to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，水西蠻平。

translations.literal: On renyin, the tribes of western Guizhou were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, the tribes of western Guizhou were pacified.

sentences.zh: 五月壬子朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, renzi, first day of the month: there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fifth month, renzi, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，楚王楨、湘王柏帥師討古州蠻。

translations.literal: On yimao, Prince of Chu Zhen and Prince of Xiang Bai led troops to campaign against the tribes of Gu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, Prince of Chu Zhen and Prince of Xiang Bai took the field against the tribes of Gu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 六月辛巳，賜禮部覆試貢士韓克忠等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: Sixth month, xinsi: Han Kezhong and other candidates who passed the Ministry of Rites re-examination were granted, with differences in rank, the titles of Presented Scholar and Advanced Scholar.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the xinsi day, Han Kezhong and the other candidates who passed the Ministry of Rites re-examination were conferred, according to rank, the titles of Presented Scholar and Advanced Scholar.

sentences.zh: 己酉，駙馬都尉歐陽倫有罪賜死。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Chief Commandant of Horse Guards Ouyang Lun, guilty of a crime, was granted death.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, Chief Commandant of Horse Guards Ouyang Lun was sentenced to death for his offenses.

sentences.zh: 秋八月丁亥，河決開封。

translations.literal: Autumn, eighth month, dinghai: the river burst its banks at Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on the dinghai day, the river broke through at Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 甲午，李景隆為征虜大將軍，練兵河南。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Li Jinglong was made Great Pacification General of the North and drilled troops in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, Li Jinglong was appointed great northern pacification general and set to drilling troops in Henan.

sentences.zh: 九月庚戌，漢、沔寇平。

translations.literal: Ninth month, gengxu: the bandits of Han and Mian were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the gengxu day, the outlaw bands of Han and Mian were suppressed.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，麓川平緬土酋刀幹孟逐其宣慰使思倫發以叛。

translations.literal: On wuchen, the native chieftain Dao Ganmeng of Luchuan and Pingmian drove out his pacification commissioner Si Lunfa in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, the native chieftain Dao Ganmeng of Luchuan and Pingmian drove out his pacification commissioner Si Lunfa and rose in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，都督楊文為征虜將軍，代齊讓。

translations.literal: On yihai, Commander Yang Wen was made Pacification General of the North in place of Qi Rang.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, Commander Yang Wen was named northern pacification general in place of Qi Rang.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊子，停遼東海運。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, wuzi: sea transport to Liaodong was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the wuzi day, sea transport to Liaodong was suspended.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，耿炳文練兵陝西。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Geng Bingwen drilled troops in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, Geng Bingwen drilled troops in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 乙未，重建國子監先師廟成。

translations.literal: On yiwei, reconstruction of the Imperial Academy's temple to the First Teacher was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, reconstruction of the Imperial Academy's temple to the First Teacher was completed.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸酉，沐春為征虜前將軍，都督何福等副之，討刀幹孟。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, guiyou: Mu Chun was made Former Pacification General of the North, with Commander He Fu and others as deputies, to campaign against Dao Ganmeng.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the guiyou day, Mu Chun was appointed former northern pacification general, with Commander He Fu and others as his deputies, to campaign against Dao Ganmeng.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球、占城、朝鮮、暹羅、烏斯藏、泥八剌入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Ryukyu, Champa, Korea, Siam, U-Tsang, and Drigun Khan sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, embassies arrived from Ryukyu, Champa, Korea, Siam, U-Tsang, and Drigun Khan.

sentences.zh: 三十一年春正月壬戌，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: Thirty-first year, spring, first month, renxu: Heaven and Earth were greatly sacrificed to at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year, on the renxu day of the first month of spring, the emperor offered the great joint sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the southern altar.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，遣使之山東、河南課耕。

translations.literal: On yichou, envoys were dispatched to Shandong and Henan to urge plowing.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, envoys were sent to Shandong and Henan to urge the spring plowing.

sentences.zh: 二月乙酉，倭寇甯海，指揮陶鐸擊敗之。

translations.literal: Second month, yiyou: Japanese pirates raided Ninghai; Commander Tao Duo attacked and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the yiyou day, Japanese raiders struck Ninghai; Commander Tao Duo routed them.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，古州蠻平，召楊文還。

translations.literal: On xinchou, the tribes of Gu Prefecture were pacified; Yang Wen was recalled.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, the tribes of Gu Prefecture were pacified, and Yang Wen was recalled to court.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，都督僉事徐凱討平麼些蠻。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Vice Commander Xu Kai suppressed and pacified the Mosuo tribes.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, Vice Commander Xu Kai crushed the Mosuo tribes and restored order.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚辰，廷臣以朝鮮屢生釁隙請討，不許。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, gengchen: the court officials, citing repeated provocations from Korea, requested a campaign; permission was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the gengchen day, court officials, citing repeated provocations from Korea, petitioned for a punitive campaign; the emperor did not consent.

sentences.zh: 五月丁未，沐春擊刀幹孟，大敗之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, dingwei: Mu Chun attacked Dao Ganmeng and inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the dingwei day, Mu Chun struck Dao Ganmeng and won a crushing victory.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，帝不豫。

translations.literal: On jiayin, the emperor fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, the emperor fell gravely ill.

sentences.zh: 戊午，都督楊文從燕王棣，武定侯郭英從遼王植，備禦開平，俱聽燕王節制。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Military Commissioner Yang Wen followed Prince of Yan Di; Marquis Wuding Guo Ying followed Prince of Liao Zhi to prepare defenses at Kaiping—all were placed under the Prince of Yan's command.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, Commissioner Yang Wen marched with Prince of Yan Zhu Di, and Marquis Wuding Guo Ying with Prince of Liao Zhu Zhi, to ready the defenses at Kaiping; all were placed under the Prince of Yan's command.

sentences.zh: 閏月癸未，帝疾大漸。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, guimao: the emperor's illness grew greatly worse.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the guimao day, the emperor's illness turned critical.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，崩於西宮，年七十有一。

translations.literal: On yiyou, he died in the Western Palace, aged seventy-one.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, he died in the Western Palace at the age of seventy-one.

sentences.zh: 遺詔曰：「朕膺天命三十有一年，憂危積心，日勤不怠，務有益於民。

translations.literal: The death edict said: "I have received Heaven's mandate for thirty-one years; care and peril have piled upon my heart; day by day I have toiled without slackening, striving that there be benefit for the people.
translations.idiomatic: The death edict read: "I have borne Heaven's mandate for thirty-one years, with worry and peril heaped upon my heart. Day after day I have labored without rest, striving always for the people's good.

sentences.zh: 奈起自寒微，無古人之博知，好善惡惡，不及遠矣。

translations.literal: Alas, rising from humble and slight origins, I lack the ancients' broad knowledge; though I love the good and hate the evil, I fall far short of reaching afar.
translations.idiomatic: Yet I rose from humble origins and lack the ancients' vast learning; though I love the good and hate the evil, my reach falls far short.

sentences.zh: 今得萬物自然之理，其奚哀念之有。

translations.literal: Now I have attained the natural principle of the myriad things—what grief or remembrance is there for it?
translations.idiomatic: Now I have attained the natural order of all things—what cause is there for grief or regret?

sentences.zh: 皇太孫允炆仁明孝友，天下歸心，宜登大位。

translations.literal: The Grand Heir Apparent Yunwen is benevolent, bright, filial, and fraternal; all under Heaven turn their hearts to him—he should ascend the great throne.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Heir Apparent Yunwen is benevolent, bright, filial, and fraternal; the hearts of all under Heaven turn to him—he should ascend the throne.

sentences.zh: 內外文武臣僚同心輔政，以安吾民。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials within and without must with one heart assist in government, to settle my people.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials within and without must aid the government with one accord, so that my people may rest secure.

sentences.zh: 喪祭儀物，毋用金玉。

translations.literal: For funeral and sacrificial ritual objects, do not use gold or jade.
translations.idiomatic: For funeral and sacrificial regalia, do not use gold or jade.

sentences.zh: 孝陵山川因其故，毋改作。

translations.literal: The hills and waters of Xiaoling should follow their former state—do not alter or rebuild.
translations.idiomatic: The hills and waters of Xiaoling should be left as they are—do not alter them.

sentences.zh: 天下臣民，哭臨三日，皆釋服，毋妨嫁娶。

translations.literal: All subjects in the realm shall mourn for three days, then all lay aside mourning dress; do not obstruct marriage and weddings.
translations.idiomatic: All subjects in the realm shall mourn for three days, then lay aside mourning dress; marriages and weddings must not be impeded.

sentences.zh: 諸王臨國中，毋至京師。

translations.literal: The princes governing in their domains are not to come to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The princes governing their domains are not to come to the capital.

sentences.zh: 諸不在令中者，推此令從事。

translations.literal: Whatever is not covered in this edict shall be handled by extending this edict's provisions.
translations.idiomatic: Whatever is not covered by this edict shall be handled by analogy with its provisions.

sentences.zh: 」辛卯，葬孝陵。

translations.literal: " On xinmao, he was buried at Xiaoling.
translations.idiomatic: " On the xinmao day, he was buried at Xiaoling.

sentences.zh: 諡曰高皇帝，廟號太祖。

translations.literal: His posthumous title was Gaohuangdi; his temple name was Taizu.
translations.idiomatic: He was given the posthumous title Gaohuangdi and the temple name Taizu.

sentences.zh: 永樂元年，諡聖神文武欽明啟運俊德成功統天大孝高皇帝。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongle, his title was extended to Shengshen Wenwu Qinming Qiyun Junde Chenggong Tongtian Daxiao Gaohuangdi.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yongle, his posthumous title was extended to Shengshen Wenwu Qinming Qiyun Junde Chenggong Tongtian Daxiao Gaohuangdi.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖十七年，增諡開天行道肇紀立極大聖至神仁文義武俊德成功高皇帝。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Jiajing, further epithets were added: Kaitian Xingdao Zhaoji Liji Dasheng Zhishen Renwen Yiwu Junde Chenggong Gaohuangdi.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year of Jiajing, further epithets were added, making him Kaitian Xingdao Zhaoji Liji Dasheng Zhishen Renwen Yiwu Junde Chenggong Gaohuangdi.

sentences.zh: 帝天授智勇，統一方夏，緯武經文，為漢、唐、宋諸君所未及。

translations.literal: The emperor received Heaven-given wisdom and courage, unified the Central Plain, wove martial and civil arts—what the rulers of Han, Tang, and Song did not attain.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven endowed him with wisdom and courage; he unified the Central Plain and wove martial power with civil culture—surpassing the rulers of Han, Tang, and Song.

sentences.zh: 當其肇造之初，能沉幾觀變，次第經略，綽有成算。

translations.literal: At the beginning of his founding, he could observe subtle signs and changes, advance in order through strategy, and abundantly had settled plans.
translations.idiomatic: At the founding, he could read subtle signs and shifting fortunes, advance step by step in strategy, and always had a settled plan.

sentences.zh: 嘗與諸臣論取天下之略，曰：「朕遭時喪亂，初起鄉土，本圖自全。

translations.literal: Once, discussing with his ministers the strategy for taking the realm, he said: "I encountered an age of chaos and upheaval; when I first rose in my homeland, I intended only to preserve myself.
translations.idiomatic: Once, discussing with his ministers how to win the realm, he said, "I came of age in chaos and upheaval. When I first rose in my homeland, I intended only to preserve myself.

sentences.zh: 及渡江以來，觀群雄所為，徒為生民之患，而張士誠、陳友諒尤為巨蠹。

translations.literal: After crossing the river southward, observing what the rival strongmen did—they were merely afflictions for the people—and Zhang Shicheng and Chen Youliang were especially great pests.
translations.idiomatic: After crossing the Yangzi, I saw what the rival warlords did—nothing but afflict the people—and Zhang Shicheng and Chen Youliang were the worst of the plague.

sentences.zh: 士誠恃富，友諒恃強，朕獨無所恃。

translations.literal: Shicheng relied on wealth, Youliang relied on strength; I alone had nothing to rely on.
translations.idiomatic: Shicheng relied on wealth, Youliang on military might; I alone had nothing to rely on.

sentences.zh: 惟不嗜殺人，布信義，行節儉，與卿等同心共濟。

translations.literal: Only by not delighting in killing people, spreading trust and righteousness, practicing frugality, and sharing one heart with you all to cross together.
translations.idiomatic: I relied only on refusing to delight in killing, spreading trust and righteousness, practicing frugality, and sharing one purpose with you all.

sentences.zh: 初與二寇相持，士誠尤逼近。

translations.literal: At first, contending with the two foes, Shicheng especially pressed close.
translations.idiomatic: When I first contended with the two foes, Shicheng pressed in especially close.

sentences.zh: 或謂宜先擊之。

translations.literal: Some said we should strike him first.
translations.idiomatic: Some urged that we strike him first.

sentences.zh: 朕以友諒志驕，士誠器小，志驕則好生事，器小則無遠圓，故先攻友諒。

translations.literal: I judged Youliang ambitious and arrogant, Shicheng petty in capacity; ambition leads to delight in trouble-making, pettiness lacks long vision—so I attacked Youliang first.
translations.idiomatic: I judged Youliang ambitious and arrogant, Shicheng small-minded; the ambitious love to stir trouble, the small-minded lack long vision—so I attacked Youliang first.

sentences.zh: 鄱陽之役，士誠卒不能出姑蘇一步以為之援。

translations.literal: In the Poyang campaign, Shicheng in the end could not move one step from Gusu to aid him.
translations.idiomatic: At Poyang, Shicheng in the end could not stir one step from Gusu to aid him.

sentences.zh: 向使先攻士誠，浙西負固堅守，友諒必空國而來，吾腹背受敵矣。

translations.literal: Had we first attacked Shicheng, western Zhe would have held fast in stubborn defense; Youliang would certainly have emptied his state and come—we would have been caught front and rear.
translations.idiomatic: Had we attacked Shicheng first, western Zhe would have held fast, and Youliang would surely have emptied his state and marched against us—we would have been caught between two enemies.

sentences.zh: 二寇既除，北定中原，所以先山東、次河洛，止潼關之兵不遽取秦、隴者，蓋擴廓帖木兒、李思齊、張思道皆百戰之餘，未肯遽下，急之則並力一隅，猝未易定，故出其不意，反旆而北。

translations.literal: Once the two foes were removed and the Central Plain was settled in the north, the reason we first took Shandong, then the Luo region, and halted the troops at Tong Pass without rushing to seize Qin and Long was that Köke Temür, Li Siqi, and Zhang Sidao were all veterans of a hundred battles, unwilling to submit at once; pressing them would unite their strength in one corner and they could not quickly be settled—so we took them unawares and turned our banners north.
translations.idiomatic: After the two foes were gone and we moved to settle the north, we took Shandong first, then the Luo basin, and held our forces at Tong Pass without rushing into Qin and Long because Köke Temür, Li Siqi, and Zhang Sidao were all battle-hardened veterans who would not submit at once; press them too hard and they would unite in one corner and not be quickly subdued—so we struck where they did not expect and wheeled our banners north.

sentences.zh: 燕都既舉，然後西征。

translations.literal: Once the Yan capital was taken, then the western campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Only after Yan capital fell did we march west.

sentences.zh: 張、李望絕勢窮，不戰而克，然擴廓猶力抗不屈。

translations.literal: Zhang and Li saw hope exhausted and strength spent, and submitted without battle; yet Köke Temür still resisted with force and would not yield.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang and Li saw hope exhausted and submitted without a fight, yet Köke Temür still fought on and would not yield.

sentences.zh: 向令未下燕都，驟與角力，勝負未可知也。

translations.literal: Had we not taken the Yan capital first and suddenly contended with him, victory or defeat would have been unknown.
translations.idiomatic: Had we not taken Yan capital first and suddenly grappled with him, the outcome would have been uncertain.

sentences.zh: 」帝之雄才大略，料敵制勝，率類此。

translations.literal: " The emperor's heroic talent and grand design, gauging the enemy and achieving victory, were mostly of this kind.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor's heroic talent and grand design—reading the enemy and winning—were mostly of this kind.

sentences.zh: 故能戡定禍亂，以有天下。

translations.literal: Thus he could quell and settle turmoil and disorder, and thereby possess the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Thus he could quell turmoil and win the realm.

sentences.zh: 語雲「天道後起者勝」，豈偶然哉。

translations.literal: The saying runs, "Heaven's way favors the latecomer"—how could it be mere chance?
translations.idiomatic: The saying runs, "Heaven's way favors the latecomer"—how could that be mere chance?

sentences.zh: 贊曰：太祖以聰明神武之資，抱濟世安民之志，乘時應運，豪傑景從，戡亂摧強，十五載而成帝業。

translations.literal: The eulogy says: Taizu, with the endowment of keen intelligence and divine martial prowess, cherished the will to succor the age and settle the people; riding the times and answering fortune, heroes gathered to follow; he quelled disorder and crushed the strong, and in fifteen years accomplished the imperial enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: The eulogy says: Taizu possessed keen intelligence and divine martial prowess, and cherished the will to succor the age and settle the people. Riding the times and answering fortune, heroes gathered to his banner; he quelled disorder and crushed the strong, and in fifteen years accomplished the imperial enterprise.

sentences.zh: 崛起布衣，奄奠海宇，西漢以後所未有也。

translations.literal: Rising from common cloth, he covered the sea and land in a moment—what none had achieved since the Western Han.
translations.idiomatic: He rose from common cloth to cover the realm in a moment—something unseen since the Western Han.

sentences.zh: 懲元政廢弛，治尚嚴峻。

translations.literal: Punishing the Yuan government's laxity and slackness, his governance valued severity.
translations.idiomatic: Punishing the Yuan government's lax rule, his administration valued severity.

sentences.zh: 而能禮致耆儒，考禮定樂，昭揭經義，尊崇正學，加恩勝國，澄清吏治，修人紀，崇鳳都，正後宮名義，內治肅清，禁宦豎不得幹政，五府六部官職相維，置衛屯田，兵食俱足。

translations.literal: Yet he could honor aged scholars with ritual, examine rites and fix music, display and proclaim the classics' meaning, revere orthodox learning, show grace to the defeated dynasty, clarify official governance, repair human norms, exalt the Phoenix capital, rectify the inner palace's titles and names, keep inner administration pure, forbid eunuchs from meddling in government, interlock the offices of the Five Commissions and Six Ministries, establish guard garrison farms—troops and provisions both sufficient.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he could honor aged scholars with ritual, examine rites and fix music, proclaim the meaning of the classics, revere orthodox learning, show grace to the defeated dynasty, clarify official governance, repair human norms, exalt the capital, rectify the inner palace's titles, keep inner administration pure, forbid eunuchs from meddling in government, interlock the Five Commissions and Six Ministries, and establish guard garrison farms so that troops and provisions were both sufficient.

sentences.zh: 武定禍亂，文致太平，太祖實身兼之。

translations.literal: Martial power settled turmoil and disorder; civil culture brought great peace—Taizu truly embodied both in his person.
translations.idiomatic: Martial power settled turmoil; civil culture brought great peace—Taizu truly embodied both.

sentences.zh: 至於雅尚志節，聽蔡子英北歸。

translations.literal: As for elegantly honoring integrity of will, he allowed Cai Ziying to return north.
translations.idiomatic: He also honored integrity of character, as when he allowed Cai Ziying to return north.

sentences.zh: 晚歲憂民益切，嘗以一歲開支河暨塘堰數萬以利農桑、備旱潦。

translations.literal: In his late years he cared for the people all the more urgently; once in a single year he opened rivers and ponds and dikes by tens of thousands to benefit farming and sericulture and guard against flood and drought.
translations.idiomatic: In his late years he cared for the people all the more urgently; in a single year he once opened rivers, ponds, and dikes by the tens of thousands to benefit farming and guard against flood and drought.

sentences.zh: 用此子孫承業二百餘年，士重名義，閭閻充實。

translations.literal: Because of this, his descendants inherited the enterprise for more than two hundred years; scholars valued reputation and duty, and villages and lanes were full.
translations.idiomatic: Because of this, his descendants held the throne for more than two hundred years; scholars valued reputation and duty, and the villages were full.

sentences.zh: 至今苗裔蒙澤，尚如東樓、白馬，世承先祀，有以哉。

translations.literal: To this day his descendants enjoy his grace, still like the lines of Donglou and Baima, generation after generation inheriting ancestral sacrifices—there is reason for it.
translations.idiomatic: To this day his descendants still enjoy his grace, like the lines of Donglou and Baima who for generations maintained ancestral sacrifices—small wonder.
